import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.util.JsonGeneratorDelegate;

public class DepthTrackingJsonGenerator extends JsonGeneratorDelegate {
    private int depth = 0;

    public DepthTrackingJsonGenerator(JsonGenerator d) {
        super(d);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeStartObject() {
        super.writeStartObject();
        depth++;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeEndObject() {
        super.writeEndObject();
        depth--;
    }

    /**
     * returns a 0 - based depth within the object graph of the current object being serialized .
     */
    public int getCurrentDepth() {
        return Math.max(0, depth - 1);
    }

    // Other overridden methods as needed
}

public class UnitTest {
    @org.junit.Test
    public void testDepthTrackingJsonGenerator_currentDepth() {
        DepthTrackingJsonGenerator jsonGenerator = new DepthTrackingJsonGenerator(null);
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 0
        jsonGenerator.writeStartObject();
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 1
        jsonGenerator.writeEndObject();
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 0
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void testDepthTrackingJsonGenerator_currentDepthMultipleObjects() {
        DepthTrackingJsonGenerator jsonGenerator = new DepthTrackingJsonGenerator(null);
        jsonGenerator.writeStartObject();
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 1
        jsonGenerator.writeStartObject();
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 2
        jsonGenerator.writeEndObject();
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 1
        jsonGenerator.writeEndObject();
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 0
    }

    public void testDepthTrackingJsonGenerator_currentDepthNestedObjects() {

        jsonGenerator.writeStartObject();

        jsonGenerator.writeEndObject();
        System.out.println(jsonGenerator.getCurrentDepth()); // Expected: 0
    }

            // For the purpose of this example, create a backing field dynamically

        }

    private object DEPTH_FIELD;

    }

            return oneBased - _NUM;
        }
        catch (Exception e when (e is TargetException || e is MethodAccessException)) {

    }

import weka.core.Instances;
public class SchemeCheck {

    /**
     * Checks whether the scheme alters the training dataset during building.
     * If the scheme needs to modify the data, it should take a copy of the training data.
     * Currently checks for changes to header structure, number of instances, order of instances, instance weights.
     */
    public static boolean checkIfSchemeAltersTrainingData(Instances before, Instances after) {
        // Check if header structure (number of attributes, etc.) changed
        if (!before.equalHeaders(after)) {
            return true;
        }

        // Check if number of instances changed
        if (before.numInstances() != after.numInstances()) {
            return true;
        }

        // Check if instance order changed and if instance weights changed
        for (int i = 0; i < before.numInstances(); i++) {
            Instance beforeInstance = before.instance(i);
            Instance afterInstance = after.instance(i);

            // Check for instance reference (order changed)
            if (!beforeInstance.equals(afterInstance)) {
                return true;
            }

            // Check for instance weights changed
            if (beforeInstance.weight() != afterInstance.weight()) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Instances before = new Instances(5, 3);
        before.setClassIndex(0);

        Instances after = new Instances(5, 3);
        after.setClassIndex(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            Instance instance = new weka.core.Instance(3);
            instance.set("A", 1); // A
            instance.set("B", 2); // B
            instance.set("C", 3); // C
            after.instance(i).set(instance);
        }

        System.out.println(checkIfSchemeAltersTrainingData(before, after));
    }
}

import java.util.BitSet;

public class BitSetUnionSize {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Create two BitSets
        BitSet set1 = new BitSet();
        BitSet set2 = new BitSet();

        // Set some bits for demonstration
        set1.set(1);
        set1.set(3);
        set1.set(5);

        set2.set(2);
        set2.set(3);
        set2.set(6);

        // Compute the union of set1 and set2
        BitSet union = (BitSet) set1.clone();
        union.or(set2);

        // Get the size (cardinality) of the union
        int unionSize = union.cardinality();

        System.out.println("Union size: " + unionSize);
    }

    public static void test1() {
        BitSet set1 = new BitSet();
        BitSet set2 = new BitSet();

        set1.set(0);
        set2.set(0);

        BitSet union = (BitSet) set1.clone();
        union.or(set2);

        int unionSize = union.cardinality();

        if (unionSize == 1) {
            System.out.println("Test 1 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 1 failed");
        }
    }

import java.util.*;

public class TestOrder {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Map<String, String> local = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        local.put("key1", "val1");
        local.put("key2", "localVal2");
        local.put("key3", "val3");

        Map<String, String> remote = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        remote.put("key2", "remoteVal2");

        Map<String, String> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String key : local.keySet()) {
            if (remote.containsKey(key)) {
                merged.put(key, remote.get(key));
            } else {
                merged.put(key, local.get(key));
            }
        }

        System.out.println("Local entries:");
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : local.entrySet()) {
            System.out.println(entry.getKey() + " = " + entry.getValue());
        }

        System.out.println("\nRemote entries:");
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : remote.entrySet()) {
            System.out.println(entry.getKey() + " = " + entry.getValue());
        }

        System.out.println("\nMerged map:");
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : merged.entrySet()) {
            System.out.println(entry.getKey() + " = " + entry.getValue());
        }
    }
}

public class GridTest
{

    private const int _NUM = 1;
    private const bool _BOOL = true;

    {
        GridTest test = new GridTest();
        test.TestReverseOrder4();
        Console.WriteLine("Test completed.");
    }

    Version Version(int num)
    {
        return new Version(num, 0);
    }

    public void TestReverseOrder4()
    {
        Guid id = Guid.NewGuid();
        var cache = grid.InternalCache();
        var ctx = cache.Context();

        var entry1 = new GridCacheTestEntryEx(ctx, _STR);
        var entry2 = new GridCacheTestEntryEx(ctx, _STR);

        var ver1 = Version(_NUM);
        var ver2 = Version(_NUM);
        var ver3 = Version(_NUM);

        var v3k1 = entry1.AddLocal(_NUM, ver3, _NUM, _BOOL, _BOOL);
        var v3k2 = entry2.AddLocal(_NUM, ver3, _NUM, _BOOL, _BOOL);

        LinkCandidates(ctx, v3k1, v3k2);

        entry1.ReadyLocal(ver3);

        CheckLocal(v3k1, ver3, _BOOL, _BOOL, _BOOL);
        CheckLocal(v3k2, ver3, _BOOL, _BOOL, _BOOL);

        var v1k1 = entry1.AddLocal(_NUM, ver1, _NUM, _BOOL, _BOOL);
        var v1k2 = entry2.AddLocal(_NUM, ver1, _NUM, _BOOL, _BOOL);
    }

    void LinkCandidates(Context ctx, Candidate c1, Candidate c2)
    {
        c1.LinkedCandidate = c2;
        c2 LinkedCandidate = c1;
    }

    void CheckLocal(Candidate candidate, Version version, bool b1, bool b2, bool b3)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"CheckLocal: Candidate={candidate}, Version={version}, Flags={b1},{b2},{b3}");
    }
}

import org.junit.Test;

public class TestOrderTest {

    @Test
    public void testMergeLocalAndRemote() {
        Map<String, String> local = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        local.put("key1", "val1");
        local.put("key2", "localVal2");
        local.put("key3", "val3");

        Map<String, String> remote = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        remote.put("key2", "remoteVal2");

        Map<String, String> merged = mergeLocalAndRemote(local, remote);

        System.out.println(merged);
    }

    @Test
    public void testMergeLocalAndRemoteEmpty() {
        Map<String, String> local = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, String> remote = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        Map<String, String> merged = mergeLocalAndRemote(local, remote);

        System.out.println(merged);
    }

    @Test
    public void testMergeLocalAndRemoteKeyNotPresent() {
        Map<String, String> local = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        local.put("key1", "val1");
        local.put("key3", "val3");

        Map<String, String> remote = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        remote.put("key2", "remoteVal2");

        Map<String, String> merged = mergeLocalAndRemote(local, remote);

        System.out.println(merged);
    }

    @Test
    public void testMergeLocalAndRemoteAllPresent() {
        Map<String, String> local = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        local.put("key1", "val1");
        local.put("key2", "localVal2");
        local.put("key3", "val3");

        Map<String, String> remote = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        remote.put("key1", "remoteVal1");
        remote.put("key2", "remoteVal2");
        remote.put("key3", "remoteVal3");

        Map<String, String> merged = mergeLocalAndRemote(local, remote);

        System.out.println(merged);
    }

    public static Map<String, String> mergeLocalAndRemote(Map<String, String> local, Map<String, String> remote) {
        Map<String, String> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String key : local.keySet()) {
            if (remote.containsKey(key)) {
                merged.put(key, remote.get(key));
            } else {
                merged.put(key, local.get(key));
            }
        }

        return merged;
    }
}

    }

using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace MyApp
{
    public class DialogHandlerTest
    {
        [TestMethod]
        public void testDialogOkClosed() 
        {
            AddUserFieldsCustomizer customizer = new AddUserFieldsCustomizer();
            List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs = new List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec>();
            spec1(specs, 0);
            spec2(specs, 0);
            customizer.ClosingOK();
        }

        public static void spec1(List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs, int index) 
        {
            specs.Add(new AddUserFields.AttributeSpec("FirstName"));
        }

        public static void spec2(List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs, int index) 
        {
            specs.Add(new AddUserFields.AttributeSpec("LastName"));
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void testDialogOkClosed_EmptyList() 
        {
            AddUserFieldsCustomizer customizer = new AddUserFieldsCustomizer();
            List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs = new List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec>();
            spec1(specs, 0);
            customizer.ClosingOK();
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void testDialogOkClosed_MultipleAttributes() 
        {
            AddUserFieldsCustomizer customizer = new AddUserFieldsCustomizer();
            List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs = new List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec>();
            spec1(specs, 0);
            spec2(specs, 0);
            customizer.ClosingOK();
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void testDialogOkClosed_NoModifyL() 
        {
            AddUserFieldsCustomizer customizer = new AddUserFieldsCustomizer();
            List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs = new List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec>();
            spec1(specs, 0);
            customizer.m_modifyL = null;
            customizer.ClosingOK();
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void testDialogOkClosed_ModifyL() 
        {
            AddUserFieldsCustomizer customizer = new AddUserFieldsCustomizer();
            List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs = new List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec>();
            spec1(specs, 0);
            ModifyL modifyL = new ModifyL();
            customizer.m_modifyL = modifyL;
            customizer.ClosingOK();
        }
    }

    public class AddUserFieldsCustomizer 
    {
        protected const int _NUM = 1;   // example value for demonstration
        protected const bool _BOOL = true;

        protected List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> m_listModel;
        protected IModifyL m_modifyL;
        protected Filter m_filter;

        public AddUserFieldsCustomizer() 
        {
            // For demonstration, initialize with 3 attributes
            m_listModel = new List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec>()
            {
                new AddUserFields.AttributeSpec("FirstName"),
                new AddUserFields.AttributeSpec("LastName"),
                new AddUserFields.AttributeSpec("Email")
            };
            m_modifyL = new ModifyL();
            m_filter = new Filter();
        }

        public virtual void ClosingOK() 
        {
            List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs = new List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec>();
            for (int i = _NUM; i < m_listModel.Count; i++)
            {
                AddUserFields.AttributeSpec a = (AddUserFields.AttributeSpec)m_listModel[i];
                specs.Add(a);
            }
            if (m_modifyL != null)
            {
                m_modifyL.SetModifiedStatus(this, _BOOL);
            }
            m_filter.SetAttributeSpecs(specs);
        }

    }

}

public interface IModifyL 
{
    void SetModifiedStatus(object sender, bool modified);
}

public class ModifyL : IModifyL
{
    public void SetModifiedStatus(object sender, bool modified)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Modified status set to: " + modified);
    }
}

public class Filter 
{
    public void SetAttributeSpecs(List<AddUserFields.AttributeSpec> specs) 
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Specs set with {0} attribute(s):", specs.Count);
        foreach (var spec in specs)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("- {0}", spec.Name);
        }
    }
}

public class ClassAttribute
{
    private string[] _values;

    public ClassAttribute(string[] values)
    {
        _values = values;
    }

    public int NumValues()
    {
        return _values.Length;
    }

    public string Value(int i)
    {
        return _values[i];
    }
}

public class Kernel
{
    public override string ToString()
    {
        return "DummyKernel";
    }
}

public class Logistic
{
    public override string ToString()
    {
        return "LogisticModel";
    }
}

public class Classifier
{
    public Logistic m_logistic;

    public Classifier()
    {
        m_logistic = new Logistic();
    }

    public Classifier(bool hasLogistic)
    {
        m_logistic = hasLogistic ? new Logistic() : null;
    }

    public override string ToString()
    {
        return "Classifier";
    }
}

public class MyPrinter
{
    private string _STR = "|";
    private int _NUM = 0;

    public ClassAttribute m_classAttribute;
    public Kernel m_kernel;
    public bool m_fitLogisticModels;
    public Classifier[][] m_classifiers;

    public MyPrinter()
    {
        // Example Initialization
        m_classAttribute = new ClassAttribute(new string[] { "A", "B", "C" });
        m_kernel = new Kernel();
        m_fitLogisticModels = true;
        int n = m_classAttribute.NumValues();
        m_classifiers = new Classifier[n][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            m_classifiers[i] = new Classifier[n];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                // add a Logistic only for i + j even
                m_classifiers[i][j] = new Classifier((i + j) % 2 == 0);
            }
        }
    }

    // prints out the classifier
    public override string ToString()
    {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        if (m_classAttribute == null)
        {
            return _STR;
        }
        try
        {
            text.Append(_STR);
            text.Append(_STR + m_kernel.ToString() + _STR);
            for (int i = _NUM; i < m_classAttribute.NumValues(); i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + _NUM; j < m_classAttribute.NumValues(); j++)
                {
                    text.Append(_STR + m_classAttribute.Value(i) + _STR + m_classAttribute.Value(j) + _STR);
                    text.Append(m_classifiers[i][j]);
                    if (m_fitLogisticModels)
                    {
                        text.Append(_STR);
                        if (m_classifiers[i][j].m_logistic == null)
                        {
                            text.Append(_STR);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            text.Append(m_classifiers[i][j].m_logistic.ToString());
                        }
                    }
                    text.Append(_STR);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return _STR;
        }
        return text.ToString();
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        MyPrinter printer = new MyPrinter();
        Console.WriteLine(printer.ToString());
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class Sector {
    private double minLatitude;
    private double maxLatitude;
    private double minLongitude;
    private double maxLongitude;

    public Sector(double minLatitude, double maxLatitude, double minLongitude, double maxLongitude) {
        this.minLatitude = minLatitude;
        this.maxLatitude = maxLatitude;
        this.minLongitude = minLongitude;
        this.maxLongitude = maxLongitude;
    }

    public Sector union(Sector sector) {
        double minLat = Math.min(this.minLatitude, sector.minLatitude);
        double maxLat = Math.max(this.maxLatitude, sector.maxLatitude);
        double minLon = Math.min(this.minLongitude, sector.minLongitude);
        double maxLon = Math.max(this.maxLongitude, sector.maxLongitude);
        return new Sector(minLat, maxLat, minLon, maxLon);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("Sector[minLatitude=%.2f, maxLatitude=%.2f, minLongitude=%.2f, maxLongitude=%.2f]", 
                             minLatitude, maxLatitude, minLongitude, maxLongitude);
    }
}

public class SectorTests {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Sector sector1 = new Sector(-20.0, 10.0, 30.0, 70.0);
        Sector sector2 = new Sector(0.0, 40.0, 20.0, 50.0);

        Sector unionSector = sector1.union(sector2);

        System.out.println("Sector 1: " + sector1);
        System.out.println("Sector 2: " + sector2);
        System.out.println("Union Sector: " + unionSector);
    }

    public static void test1() {
        Sector sector1 = new Sector(-20.0, 10.0, 30.0, 70.0);
        Sector sector2 = new Sector(0.0, 40.0, 20.0, 50.0);

        Sector unionSector = sector1.union(sector2);

        assertDoubleEqual(unionSector.minLatitude, -20.0);
        assertDoubleEqual(unionSector.maxLatitude, 40.0);
        assertDoubleEqual(unionSector.minLongitude, 20.0);
        assertDoubleEqual(unionSector.maxLongitude, 70.0);
    }

    public static void test2() {

        assertDoubleEqual(unionSector.minLatitude, -10.0);
        assertDoubleEqual(unionSector.maxLatitude, 35.0);

public class DoubleEqualityChecker {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        double a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        double b = 0.3;
        double epsilon = 1e-9;

        if (Math.abs(a - b) < epsilon) {
            System.out.println("a and b are equal (within tolerance).");
        } else {
            System.out.println("a and b are NOT equal.");
        }
    }

    public static void testDoubleEqualityChecker() {
        double a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        double b = 0.3;
        double epsilon = 1e-9;

        if (Math.abs(a - b) < epsilon) {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.3;
        epsilon = 1e-10;

        if (Math.abs(a - b) < epsilon) {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.3;
        epsilon = 1e-5;

        if (Math.abs(a - b) < epsilon) {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.3;
        epsilon = 1e-8;

        if (Math.abs(a - b) < epsilon) {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.4;
        epsilon = 1e-9;

        if (Math.abs(a - b) < epsilon) {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test: IsDoubleEquality failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {epsilon}");
        }
    }

    public static void runUnitTests() {
        testDoubleEqualityChecker();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        runUnitTests();
    }
}

public class DoubleEqualityCheckerCSharp {
    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        double a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        double b = 0.3;

        Console.WriteLine($"Is {a} equal to {b}? {DoubleEqualityCheckerCSharp.IsDoubleEqual(a, b)}");

        testDoubleEqualityCheckerCSharp();

    }

    public static void testDoubleEqualityCheckerCSharp() {
        double a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        double b = 0.3;
        double _NUM = 1e-9;

        if (Math.Abs(a - b) < _NUM) {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.3;
        _NUM = 1e-10;

        if (Math.Abs(a - b) < _NUM) {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.3;
        _NUM = 1e-5;

        if (Math.Abs(a - b) < _NUM) {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.3;
        _NUM = 1e-8;

        if (Math.Abs(a - b) < _NUM) {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        }

        a = 0.1 + 0.2;
        b = 0.4;
        _NUM = 1e-9;

        if (Math.Abs(a - b) < _NUM) {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual passed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Test: IsDoubleEqual failed for inputs {a}, {b}, with tolerance {_NUM}");
        }
    }

    public static bool IsDoubleEqual(double value, double valueToCompare)
    {
        return (Math.Abs(value - valueToCompare) < _NUM);
    }

}

public class Main {

        // Integer value of a positive BigDecimal

        int intValue = bigDecimalValue.intValue();

using System;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace BigDecimalTest
{
    public class Tests
    {
        private const string _STR = "123";
        private const int _NUM = 123;

        [Test]
        public void TestIntValuePos()
        {
            string a = _STR;
            decimal aNumber = decimal.Parse(a);
            int result = -_NUM;
            Assert.IsTrue(aNumber == result, _STR);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TestIntValueNeg()
        {
            string a = "-123";
            decimal aNumber = decimal.Parse(a);
            int result = -aNumber;
            Assert.AreEqual(result, -_NUM, _STR);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TestIntValueZero()
        {
            string a = "0";
            decimal aNumber = decimal.Parse(a);
            int result = 0;
            Assert.AreEqual(result, aNumber, _STR);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TestIntValueVeryLarge()
        {
            string a = "12345678901234567890.12345";
            decimal aNumber = decimal.Parse(a);
            int result = -aNumber;
            Assert.IsTrue(result == -_NUM, _STR);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TestIntValueZeroDecimalPart()
        {
            string a = "0.0";
            decimal aNumber = decimal.Parse(a);
            int result = 0;
            Assert.AreEqual(result, aNumber, _STR);
        }
}

public class Main {

import java.io.File;

public class DirectoryExaminer {

    // Main recursive method to examine the directory hierarchy
    public static void examineDirectory(File dir) {
        if (dir == null || !dir.exists()) {
            System.out.println("Directory does not exist: " + dir);
            return;
        }
        if (dir.isDirectory()) {
            System.out.println("Directory: " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
            File[] files = dir.listFiles();
            if (files != null) {
                for (File file : files) {
                    examineDirectory(file);
                }
            }
        } else {
            System.out.println("File: " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // You can change this path to any directory you want to examine
        File startDir = new File(".");
        examineDirectory(startDir);
    }
}

import org.junit.Test;
import java.io.File;

public class DirectoryExaminerTest {

    @Test
    public void testEmptyDirectory() {
        File dir = new File("test");
        if (dir.exists()) {
            dir.delete();
        }
        dir.mkdirs();
        examineDirectory(dir);
        assert dir.listFiles().length == 0;
    }

    @Test
    public void testFileInDirectory() {
        File dir = new File("test");
        File file = new File(dir, "file.txt");
        if (dir.exists()) {
            dir.delete();
        }
        dir.mkdirs();
        file.createNewFile();
        examineDirectory(dir);
        assert file.exists();
    }

    @Test
    public void testNestedDirectory() {
        File dir1 = new File("test");
        File dir2 = new File(dir1, "subdir");
        if (dir1.exists()) {
            dir1.delete();
        }
        dir1.mkdirs();
        if (dir2.exists()) {
            dir2.delete();
        }
        dir2.mkdirs();
        examineDirectory(dir1);
        assert dir2.exists();
    }

    @Test
    public void testMultipleFilesAndDirectories() {
        File dir = new File("test");
        File file1 = new File(dir, "file1.txt");
        File file2 = new File(dir, "file2.txt");
        File dir2 = new File(dir, "subdir");
        if (dir.exists()) {
            dir.delete();
        }
        dir.mkdirs();
        file1.createNewFile();
        file2.createNewFile();
        if (dir2.exists()) {
            dir2.delete();
        }
        dir2.mkdirs();
        examineDirectory(dir);
        assert file1.exists();
        assert file2.exists();
        assert dir2.exists();
    }

    @Test
    public void testNullDirectory() {
        File dir = null;
        try {
            examineDirectory(dir);
            assert false;
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {
            assert true;
        }
    }
}

```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;

namespace DirectoryWalkerApp
{
    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var results = new List<string>();
            var walker = new DirectoryWalker<string>();
            var startDir = new DirectoryInfo(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory());
            walker.Walk(startDir, 0, results);

            Console.WriteLine("Results:");
            foreach (var result in results)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(result);
            }
        }
    }

    public class DirectoryWalker<T>
    {
        protected int _NUM = 1;
        protected int depthLimit = -1; // -1 means no limit
        protected Func<FileInfo, bool> filter = null;

        // Main recursive method to examine the directory hierarchy.
        public void Walk(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, ICollection<T> results)
        {
            CheckIfCancelled(directory, depth, results);

            if (HandleDirectory(directory, depth, results))
            {
                HandleDirectoryStart(directory, depth, results);
                int childDepth = depth + _NUM;
                if (depthLimit < _NUM || childDepth <= depthLimit)
                {
                    CheckIfCancelled(directory, depth, results);
                    FileInfo[] childFiles = filter == null
                        ? directory.GetFiles("*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
                        : directory.GetFiles("*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly).Where(file => filter(file)).ToArray();

                    childFiles = FilterDirectoryContents(directory, depth, childFiles);

                    if (childFiles == null)
                    {
                        HandleRestricted(directory, childDepth, results);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        foreach (var childFile in childFiles)
                        {
                            if (IsDirectory(childFile))
                            {
                                Walk(new DirectoryInfo(childFile.FullName), childDepth, results);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                CheckIfCancelled(childFile, childDepth, results);
                                HandleFile(childFile, childDepth, results);
                                CheckIfCancelled(childFile, childDepth, results);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                HandleDirectoryEnd(directory, depth, results);
            }
        }

        protected virtual bool HandleDirectory(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, ICollection<T> results)
        {
            // Process or filter directories, return true to walk into it.
            return true;
        }

        protected virtual void HandleDirectoryStart(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, ICollection<T> results)
        {
            results.Add((T)(object)($"Entering directory: {new string(' ', depth * 2)}{directory.FullName}"));
        }

        protected virtual void HandleDirectoryEnd(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, ICollection<T> results)
        {
            results.Add((T)(object)($"Leaving directory: {new string(' ', depth * 2)}{directory.FullName}"));
        }

        protected virtual void HandleRestricted(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, ICollection<T> results)
        {
            results.Add((T)(object)($"Restricted directory: {new string(' ', depth * 2)}{directory.FullName}"));
        }

        protected virtual FileInfo[] FilterDirectoryContents(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, FileInfo[] files)
        {
            // Here, return files as-is. Override for custom filtering.
            return files;
        }

        protected virtual void HandleFile(FileInfo file, int depth, ICollection<T> results)
        {
            results.Add((T)(object)($"{new string(' ', depth * 2)}File: {file.FullName}"));
        }

        protected virtual void CheckIfCancelled(object item, int depth, ICollection<T> results)
        {
            // Dummy cancellation check.
            // Throw exception here if you want to cancel/abort.
        }

        protected bool IsDirectory(FileInfo file)
        {
            // In .NET, FileInfo doesn't represent a directory.
            // So, try to check if a corresponding Directory exists.
            return Directory.Exists(file.FullName);
        }
    }
}

```java
import org.junit.Test;
import java.util.*;

class Tuple {
    private Object[] fields;

    public Tuple(Object[] fields) {
        this.fields = fields;
    }

    public Object getField(int i) {
        return fields[i];
    }
}

class TupleIterator implements Iterator<Tuple> {
    private List<Tuple> tuples;
    private int index = 0;

    public TupleIterator(List<Tuple> tuples) {
        this.tuples = tuples;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasNext() {
        return index < tuples.size();
    }

    @Override
    public Tuple next() {
        return tuples.get(index++);
    }
}

public class SortedFieldValues {

    public static Comparable[] getSortedFieldValues(Iterator<Tuple> it, int field) {
        List<Comparable> values = new ArrayList<>();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Object val = it.next().getField(field);
            if (val instanceof Comparable) {
                values.add((Comparable) val);
            }
        }
        Collections.sort(values);
        return values.toArray(new Comparable[0]);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<Tuple> tuples = Arrays.asList(
            new Tuple(new Object[] {1, "Alice", 4.5}),
            new Tuple(new Object[] {3, "Bob", 2.1}),
            new Tuple(new Object[] {2, "Carol", 7.8}),
            new Tuple(new Object[] {4, "Dave", 5.3})
        );

        TupleIterator it = new TupleIterator(tuples);

        // Get sorted Integer field (e.g., field 0)
        Comparable[] sortedField0 = getSortedFieldValues(it, 0);
        System.out.println("Sorted values in field 0: " + Arrays.toString(sortedField0));

        // Get sorted Double field (e.g., field 2)
        Comparable[] sortedField2 = getSortedFieldValues(it, 2);
        System.out.println("Sorted values in field 2: " + Arrays.toString(sortedField2));
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class TupleSet : IEnumerable<Dictionary<string, object>>
{
    private List<Dictionary<string, object>> tuples = new List<Dictionary<string, object>>();

    public void Add(Dictionary<string, object> tuple)
    {
        tuples.Add(tuple);
    }

    public IEnumerator<Dictionary<string, object>> GetEnumerator()
    {
        return tuples.GetEnumerator();
    }

    IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
    {
        return GetEnumerator();
    }
}

public class DefaultLiteralComparator : IComparer<object>
{
    public static readonly DefaultLiteralComparator Instance = new DefaultLiteralComparator();

    public int Compare(object x, object y)
    {
        return Comparer<object>.Default.Compare(x, y);
    }
}

public class Program
{
    // get a sorted array containing all column values for a given tuple iterator and field
    public static object[] OrdinalArray(TupleSet tuples, string field)
    {
        return OrdinalArray(tuples, field, DefaultLiteralComparator.Instance);
    }

    public static object[] OrdinalArray(TupleSet tuples, string field, IComparer<object> comparer)
    {
        List<object> values = new List<object>();
        foreach (var tuple in tuples)
        {
            if (tuple.ContainsKey(field))
                values.Add(tuple[field]);
        }
        values.Sort(comparer);
        return values.ToArray();
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        TupleSet tuples = new TupleSet();
        tuples.Add(new Dictionary<string, object> { { "id", 3 }, { "name", "Alice" } });
        tuples.Add(new Dictionary<string, object> { { "id", 1 }, { "name", "Bob" } });
        tuples.Add(new Dictionary<string, object> { { "id", 2 }, { "name", "Charlie" } });

        object[] sortedIds = OrdinalArray(tuples, "id");
        Console.WriteLine("Sorted IDs:");
        foreach (var id in sortedIds)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(id);
        }
    }
}

public class SortedFieldValuesTest {

    @Test
    public void testGetSortedFieldValues() {
        List<Tuple> tuples = Arrays.asList(
            new Tuple(new Object[] {1, "Alice", 4.5}),
            new Tuple(new Object[] {3, "Bob", 2.1}),
            new Tuple(new Object[] {2, "Carol", 7.8}),
            new Tuple(new Object[] {4, "Dave", 5.3})
        );

        TupleIterator it = new TupleIterator(tuples);

        // Get sorted Integer field (e.g., field 0)
        Comparable[] sortedField0 = SortedFieldValues.getSortedFieldValues(it, 0);
        int[] expected0 = {1, 2, 3, 4};
        assertArrayEquals(expected0, sortedField0);

        // Get sorted Double field (e.g., field 2)
        Comparable[] sortedField2 = SortedFieldValues.getSortedFieldValues(it, 2);

        assertArrayEquals(expected2, sortedField2);

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Random;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BigDecimal a = new BigDecimal("10");
        BigDecimal b = new BigDecimal("3");
        try {
            // Divide with an invalid rounding mode (-1 is not a valid RoundingMode)
            BigDecimal result = a.divide(b, 2, -1);
            System.out.println("Result: " + result);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            System.out.println("Exception caught: " + e);
        }
    }

    public static void testDivideExceptionInvalidRM() {
        BigDecimal a = new BigDecimal("10");
        BigDecimal b = new BigDecimal("3");
        int invalidRoundingMode = -1;
        try {
            a.divide(b, 2, invalidRoundingMode);
            Assert.fail();
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            if (!e.getMessage().contains("Invalid rounding mode")) {
                Assert.fail();
            }
        }
    }

import org.jfree.chart.ChartFactory;
import org.jfree.chart.ChartPanel;
import org.jfree.chart.JFreeChart;
import org.jfree.chart.event.DatasetChangeEvent;
import org.jfree.chart.event.DatasetChangeListener;
import org.jfree.chart.plot.XYPlot;
import org.jfree.data.xy.XYDataset;
import org.jfree.data.xy.XYSeries;
import org.jfree.data.xy.XYSeriesCollection;

import javax.swing.JFrame;
import java.awt.BorderLayout;

public class DatasetNotificationDemo extends JFrame implements DatasetChangeListener {

    private XYPlot plot;

    public DatasetNotificationDemo(String title) {
        super(title);

        // Create dataset
        XYDataset dataset = createDataset();

        // Create chart
        JFreeChart chart = ChartFactory.createXYLineChart(
                "Dataset Notification Demo",
                "X",
                "Y",
                dataset
        );

        // Get plot
        plot = chart.getXYPlot();

        // Add the dataset change listener
        ((XYSeriesCollection) dataset).addChangeListener(this);

        // Create Panel
        ChartPanel chartPanel = new ChartPanel(chart);
        setContentPane(chartPanel);

        setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
        setSize(600, 400);
        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
    }

    private XYDataset createDataset() {
        XYSeries series = new XYSeries("Series 1");
        series.add(1, 1);
        series.add(2, 4);
        series.add(3, 3);
        XYSeriesCollection dataset = new XYSeriesCollection();
        dataset.addSeries(series);
        return dataset;
    }

    // Responds to notification renderer and all the dataset.
    // Receives notification of a change to the plot's dataset.
    // The axis ranges are updated if necessary.
    @Override
    public void datasetChanged(DatasetChangeEvent event) {
        System.out.println("Dataset changed. Updating axis ranges if necessary...");
        plot.configureDomainAxes();
        plot.configureRangeAxes();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        java.awt.EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> {
            DatasetNotificationDemo demo = new DatasetNotificationDemo("Dataset Notification Demo");
            demo.setVisible(true);

            // Simulate a change in the dataset after 2 seconds
            new javax.swing.Timer(2000, e -> {
                XYSeriesCollection dataset = (XYSeriesCollection) demo.plot.getDataset();
                XYSeries series = dataset.getSeries(0);
                series.add(4, 10); // This triggers a dataset change event
            }).start();
        });
    }
}

            return dataset;

            System.Console.WriteLine("Dataset changed. Updating axis ranges if necessary...");
            plot.ConfigureDomainAxes();
            plot.ConfigureRangeAxes();
        }
    }

```java
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class ApiExample {

    static class Entry {
        String user;
        String url;
        String data;

        Entry(String user, String url, String data) {
            this.user = user;
            this.url = url;
            this.data = data;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return "Entry{" +
                    "user='" + user + '\'' +
                    ", url='" + url + '\'' +
                    ", data='" + data + '\'' +
                    '}';
        }
    }

    private final Map<String, Map<String, Entry>> entries = new HashMap<>();

    /**
     * API method. Returns an entry for the source indexed by the user and the url.
     * This method creates it if it didn't already exist.
     */
    public Entry updateDataFor(String user, String url, String newData) {
        entries.putIfAbsent(user, new HashMap<>());
        Map<String, Entry> urlMap = entries.get(user);

        Entry entry = urlMap.get(url);
        if (entry == null) {
            entry = new Entry(user, url, newData);
            urlMap.put(url, entry);
        } else {
            entry.data = newData; // Update data
        }
        return entry;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ApiExample api = new ApiExample();

        Entry e1 = api.updateDataFor("alice", "http://example.com/source1", "first update");
        System.out.println(e1);

        Entry e2 = api.updateDataFor("alice", "http://example.com/source1", "second update");
        System.out.println(e2);

        Entry e3 = api.updateDataFor("bob", "http://example.com/source1", "bob's data");
        System.out.println(e3);

        Entry e4 = api.updateDataFor("alice", "http://example.com/source2", "new url data");
        System.out.println(e4);
    }
}

import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.*;

public class ApiExampleTest {

import java.util.List;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class SqlValidator {

    /**
     * Validates the given SQL statement where its position in the list of statements is the given index.
     * Note: This method does not validate SQL syntax.
     */
    public static boolean validateSqlStatement(List<String> sqlStatements, int index) {
        if (sqlStatements == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (index < 0 || index >= sqlStatements.size()) {
            return false;
        }
        String statement = sqlStatements.get(index);
        // Example validation: Check that statement is not null or empty, not just whitespace.
        if (statement == null || statement.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        // Add other validation logic as necessary (e.g., length, specific forbidden substrings, etc.)
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<String> statements = new ArrayList<>();
        statements.add("SELECT * FROM users;");
        statements.add("   ");
        statements.add(null);
        statements.add("INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 'Book');");

        for (int i = 0; i < statements.size(); i++) {
            boolean isValid = validateSqlStatement(statements, i);
            System.out.println("Statement at index " + i + " is valid: " + isValid);
        }
        // Example of index out of range
        System.out.println("Statement at index 10 is valid: " + validateSqlStatement(statements, 10));
        // Example with null list
        System.out.println("Statement at index 0 is valid: " + validateSqlStatement(null, 0));
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example collection
        java.util.List<String> list = java.util.Arrays.asList("A", "B", "C");

        // converts to object array
        Object[] arr = list.toArray();

        // Print the array elements
        for (Object obj : arr) {
            System.out.println(obj);
        }
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion() {
        java.util.List<String> list = java.util.Arrays.asList("A", "B", "C");
        Object[] arr = list.toArray();
        assert java.util.Arrays.equals(arr, new Object[]{"A", "B", "C"});
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_EmptyList() {
        java.util.List<String> list = java.util.Arrays.asList();
        Object[] arr = list.toArray();
        assert java.util.Arrays.equals(arr, new Object[]{});
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_SingleElementList() {
        java.util.List<String> list = java.util.Arrays.asList("A");
        Object[] arr = list.toArray();
        assert java.util.Arrays.equals(arr, new Object[]{"A"});
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_TypesPreserved() {
        String[] strArr = {"A", "B", "C"};
        long[] intArr = {1, 2, 3};
        Object[] arr = java.util.Arrays.merge(strArr, intArr);
        assert java.util.Arrays.equals(arr, new Object[]{"A", 1, "B", 2, "C", 3});
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_NullValue() {
        String[] strArr = {"A", null, "C"};
        long[] intArr = {1, 2, 3};
        Object[] arr = java.util.Arrays.merge(strArr, intArr);
        assert java.util.Arrays.equals(arr, new Object[]{"A", null, "B", 2, "C", 3});
    }

public class Program
{
    public static long?[] ValuesOf(long[] array)
    {
        long?[] dest = new long?[array.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
        {
            dest[i] = array[i];
        }
        return dest;
    }

    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        long[] input = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(input);

        Console.WriteLine("Converted array:");
        foreach (var val in result)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(val.HasValue ? val.Value.ToString() : "null");
        }
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion() {
        long[] input = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(input);
        assert System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5});
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_EmptyInput() {
        long[] input = {};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(input);
        assert System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long?[]{});
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_SingleElementInput() {
        long[] input = {1};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(input);
        assert System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long?[1]);
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_TypePreserved() {
        string[] strArr = {"A", "B", "C"};
        long[] intArr = {1, 2, 3};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(java.util.Arrays.merge(strArr, intArr));
        assert System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long?[0, 1, 2, 3, 4]);
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_NullValue() {
        string[] strArr = {"A", null, "C"};
        long[] intArr = {1, 2, 3};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(java.util.Arrays.merge(strArr, intArr));
        assert System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long?[0, 1, 2, 3]);
    }
}

        long[] input = {1};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(input);
        System.Diagnostics.Debug.Assert(System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long?[1]));
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_TypePreserved() {
        string[] strArr = {"A", "B", "C"};
        long[] intArr = {1, 2, 3};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(java.util.Arrays.merge(strArr, intArr));
        System.Diagnostics.Debug.Assert(System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long?[0, 1, 2, 3, 4]));
    }

    public static void testArrayConversion_NullValue() {
        string[] strArr = {"A", null, "C"};
        long[] intArr = {1, 2, 3};
        long?[] result = ValuesOf(java.util.Arrays.merge(strArr, intArr));
        System.Diagnostics.Debug.Assert(System.Linq.Enumerable.SequenceEqual(result, new long?[0, 1, 2, 3]));
    }
}

using System;

public enum LogLevel
{
    Trace,
    Debug,
    Info,
    Warn,
    Error,
    Fatal
}

public class Logger
{
   private LogLevel minLevel;

   public Logger(LogLevel level)
   {
      minLevel = level;
   }

   public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel level)
   {
      return level >= minLevel;
   }
}

public abstract class BaseLogger
{
   protected Logger logger;

   public BaseLogger(Logger logger)
   {
      this.logger = logger;
   }

   public abstract bool IsTraceEnabled();
}

public class MyLogger : BaseLogger
{
   public MyLogger(Logger logger) : base(logger) { }

   // is this logger instance enabled for the finest level ? 
   public override bool IsTraceEnabled() { return logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug); }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
       Logger logger = new Logger(LogLevel.Trace); // finest level enabled
       MyLogger myLogger = new MyLogger(logger);

       Console.WriteLine("IsTraceEnabled: " + myLogger.IsTraceEnabled());
    }
}

public class MissileGame {

    static class Player {
        private int missiles;

        public Player(int missiles) {
            this.missiles = missiles;
        }

        public int getMissiles() {
            return missiles;
        }

        public void useMissile() {
            if (missiles > 0) {
                missiles--;
            } else {
                System.out.println("No missiles left to use.");
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Player attackingPlayer = new Player(3);

        // Simulate removing an used up missile from attackingPlayer
        System.out.println("Missiles before attack: " + attackingPlayer.getMissiles());
        attackingPlayer.useMissile(); // remove a missile
        System.out.println("Missiles after attack: " + attackingPlayer.getMissiles());
    }
}

public class MissileExample
{
    public class StackableItem
    {
        public int Count { get; private set; }

        public StackableItem(int count)
        {
            Count = count;
        }

        public void RemoveOne()
        {
            if (Count > 0)
            {
                Count--;
                Console.WriteLine("One missile removed! Missiles left: " + Count);
            }
            else
            {
                Console.WriteLine("No more missiles left.");
            }
        }
    }

    public class Weapon
    {
        public string Name { get; set; }

        public Weapon(string name)
        {
            Name = name;
        }
    }

    public class Player
    {
        private Weapon _rangeWeapon;
        private StackableItem _ammunition;
        private StackableItem _missile;

        public Player(Weapon rangeWeapon, StackableItem ammunition, StackableItem missile)
        {
            _rangeWeapon = rangeWeapon;
            _ammunition = ammunition;
            _missile = missile;
        }

        public Weapon GetRangeWeapon()
        {
            return _rangeWeapon;
        }

        public StackableItem GetAmmunition()
        {
            return _ammunition;
        }

        public StackableItem GetMissileIfNotHoldingOtherWeapon()
        {
            if (_rangeWeapon == null)
                return _missile;
            return null;
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        private static void UseMissile(Player player)
        {
            StackableItem projectilesItem = null;
            if (player.GetRangeWeapon() != null)
            {
                projectilesItem = player.GetAmmunition();
            }
            if (projectilesItem == null)
            {
                projectilesItem = player.GetMissileIfNotHoldingOtherWeapon();
            }
            if (projectilesItem != null)
            {
                projectilesItem.RemoveOne();
            }
        }

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            // Player with a bow and 5 arrows
            var bow = new Weapon("Bow");
            var arrows = new StackableItem(5);
            var missile = new StackableItem(2); // backup missile
            var player = new Player(bow, arrows, missile);

            // Use missile (should remove arrow)
            UseMissile(player);
            UseMissile(player);
            UseMissile(player);
            UseMissile(player);
            UseMissile(player);
            // Now out of arrows, should try and remove missile now
            UseMissile(player);
            UseMissile(player);
            UseMissile(player); // All missiles used
        }
    }
}

public class Result {

    public boolean JavaPasses = 0;
    public boolean CSharpPasses = 0;

    public int totalPassed = 0;
    public int totalRun = 5;

    public Result(int totalRun) {
        this.totalRun = totalRun;
    }

    public void runTest(String testName, Runnable test, boolean isJava) {

        if (isJava)
            new Thread(() -> {
                try {
                    test.run();
                    JavaPasses++;
                    System.out.println(testName + " Passed!");
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    System.out.println(testName + " Failed!");
                }
            }).start();

        else
            test.run();

    }

}

public class Main {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Result result = new Result(5);

        result.runTest("test1", MissileGameTest::test1, true);
        result.runTest("test2", MissileGameTest::test2, true);
        result.runTest("test3", MissileGameTest::test3, true);
        result.runTest("test4", MissileGameTest::test4, true);
        result.runTest("test5", MissileGameTest::test5, true);

        result.runTest("test1", MissileExampleTest::test1, false);
        result.runTest("test2", MissileExampleTest::test2, false);
        result.runTest("test3", MissileExampleTest::test3, false);
        result.runTest("test4", MissileExampleTest::test4, false);
        result.runTest("test5", MissileExampleTest::test5, false);

    }

}

import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;

public class MaxLevelLessThanTest {

    @Test
    public void testFindMaxLevel() {
        TreeNode root = new TreeNode(1);
        TreeNode child1 = new TreeNode(2);
        TreeNode child2 = new TreeNode(3);
        TreeNode grandchild1 = new TreeNode(4);
        TreeNode grandchild2 = new TreeNode(5);

        root.children.add(child1);
        root.children.add(child2);
        child1.children.add(grandchild1);
        child1.children.add(grandchild2);

        int maxLevel = MaxLevelLessThan.findMaxLevel(root, 1);
        assertEquals(3, maxLevel);
    }

    @Test
    public void testFindMaxLevelHelper() {
        TreeNode root = new TreeNode(1);
        TreeNode child1 = new TreeNode(2);
        TreeNode child2 = new TreeNode(3);
        TreeNode grandchild1 = new TreeNode(4);
        TreeNode grandchild2 = new TreeNode(5);

        root.children.add(child1);
        root.children.add(child2);
        child1.children.add(grandchild1);
        child1.children.add(grandchild2);

        int maxLevel = MaxLevelLessThan.findMaxLevelHelper(root, 1);
        assertEquals(3, maxLevel);
    }

    @Test
    public void testFindMaxLevelHelperLeaf() {
        TreeNode root = new TreeNode(1);
        TreeNode leaf1 = new TreeNode(4);
        TreeNode leaf2 = new TreeNode(5);

        root.children.add(leaf1);
        root.children.add(leaf2);

        int maxLevel = MaxLevelLessThan.findMaxLevelHelper(root, 1);
        assertEquals(-1, maxLevel);
    }

    @Test
    public void testFindMaxLevelLeaf() {
        TreeNode root = new TreeNode(1);
        TreeNode leaf1 = new TreeNode(4);

        root.children.add(leaf2);

        int maxLevel = MaxLevelLessThan.findMaxLevel(root, 3);
        assertEquals(-1, maxLevel);
    }

        TreeNode root = new TreeNode(1);

        TreeNode child2 = new TreeNode(3);
        TreeNode grandchild1 = new TreeNode(4);

        child1.children.add(grandchild2);

using System;

public class MaxLevelLessThanTest {

    [Test]
    public void TestFindMaxLevel() {
        Node leaf1 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node leaf2 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node mid = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(leaf1), new Edge(leaf2) });
        Node root = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(mid) });

        int maxLevel = Program.DetermineMaxLevelRec(0, root);
        Assert.AreEqual(3, maxLevel);
    }

    [Test]
    public void TestFindMaxLevelHelper() {
        Node leaf1 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node leaf2 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node mid = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(leaf1), new Edge(leaf2) });
        Node root = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(mid) });

        int maxLevel = Program.DetermineMaxLevelRec(0, root);
        Assert.AreEqual(3, maxLevel);
    }

    [Test]
    public void TestFindMaxLevelHelperLeaf() {
        Node leaf1 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node leaf2 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node mid = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(leaf1), new Edge(leaf2) });
        Node root = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(mid) });

        int maxLevel = Program.DetermineMaxLevelRec(0, root);
        Assert.AreEqual(-1, maxLevel);
    }

    [Test]
    public void TestFindMaxLevelLeaf() {

import java.util.Scanner;

public class PasscodeVerifier {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String passCode;

        System.out.print("Enter new passcode: ");
        passCode = scanner.nextLine();

        System.out.print("Retype your passcode to confirm: ");
        String retypeCode = scanner.nextLine();

        if (passCode.equals(retypeCode)) {
            System.out.println("Passcode saved successfully!");
            // Save the passcode as needed
        } else {
            System.out.println("Passcodes do not match. Passcode not saved.");
        }

        scanner.close();
    }
}

public class PasscodeVerifierTest {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        PasscodeVerifier verifier = new PasscodeVerifier();

        // Test 1: Passcodes match
        String passCode = "1234";
        String retypeCode = "1234";
        boolean result = verifier.verifyPasscode(passCode, retypeCode);
        System.out.println("Test 1: " + (result ? "passed" : "failed"));

        // Test 2: Passcodes do not match
        passCode = "1234";
        retypeCode = "5678";
        result = verifier.verifyPasscode(passCode, retypeCode);
        System.out.println("Test 2: " + (result ? "passed" : "failed"));

        // Test 3: Empty passcodes
        passCode = "";
        retypeCode = "";
        result = verifier.verifyPasscode(passCode, retypeCode);
        System.out.println("Test 3: " + (result ? "passed" : "failed"));

        // Test 4: Null passcodes
        passCode = null;
        retypeCode = null;
        try {
            result = verifier.verifyPasscode(passCode, retypeCode);
            System.out.println("Test 4: " + (result ? "passed" : "failed"));
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {
            System.out.println("Test 4: failed");
        }

        // Test 5: Passcode too short
        passCode = "12";
        retypeCode = "12";
        result = verifier.verifyPasscode(passCode, retypeCode);
        System.out.println("Test 5: " + (result ? "passed" : "failed"));
    }
}

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public class ThreadPoolSimulation {

    private final Set<Worker> workers = new HashSet<>();
    private final AtomicInteger workerCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
    private volatile boolean terminating = false;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ThreadPoolSimulation pool = new ThreadPoolSimulation();
        Worker w = pool.new Worker();
        pool.addWorker(w);
        System.out.println("Worker added. Worker count: " + pool.workerCount.get());
        // Now roll back worker creation
        pool.rollbackWorker(w);
        System.out.println("Worker rolled back. Worker count: " + pool.workerCount.get());
    }

    public void addWorker(Worker worker) {
        synchronized (workers) {
            workers.add(worker);
            workerCount.incrementAndGet();
        }
    }

    // Rolls back the worker thread creation:
    // - removes worker from workers, if present
    // - decrements worker count
    // - rechecks for termination, in case the existence of this worker was holding up termination
    public void rollbackWorker(Worker w) {
        boolean removed;
        synchronized (workers) {
            removed = workers.remove(w);
        }
        if (removed) {
            int count = workerCount.decrementAndGet();
            System.out.println("Worker removed, count now: " + count);
        } else {
            System.out.println("Worker was not present.");
        }
        recheckTermination();
    }

    private void recheckTermination() {
        if (workerCount.get() == 0 && terminating) {
            System.out.println("All workers terminated. Pool can now shut down.");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Pool checked for termination, status OK.");
        }
    }

    public class Worker {
        // Simulating worker internals.
    }
}

public class ThreadPoolSimulation {

    private final Set<Worker> workers = new HashSet<>();
    private final AtomicInteger workerCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
    private volatile boolean terminating = false;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ThreadPoolSimulation pool = new ThreadPoolSimulation();

        pool.addWorker(w);
        System.out.println("Worker added. Worker count: " + pool.workerCount.get());
        // Now roll back worker creation
        pool.rollbackWorker(w);
        System.out.println("Worker rolled back. Worker count: " + pool.workerCount.get());
    }

    public void addWorker(Worker worker) {
        synchronized (workers) {
            workers.add(worker);
            workerCount.incrementAndGet();
        }
    }

    // Rolls back the worker thread creation:
    // - removes worker from workers, if present
    // - decrements worker count
    // - rechecks for termination, in case the existence of this worker was holding up termination
    public void rollbackWorker(Worker w) {
        boolean removed;
        synchronized (workers) {
            removed = workers.remove(w);
        }
        if (removed) {
            int count = workerCount.decrementAndGet();
            System.out.println("Worker removed, count now: " + count);
        } else {
            System.out.println("Worker was not present.");
        }
        recheckTermination();
    }

    private void recheckTermination() {
        if (workerCount.get() == 0 && terminating) {
            System.out.println("All workers terminated. Pool can now shut down.");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Pool checked for termination, status OK.");
        }
    }

import System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

public class Worker
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public Worker(string name)
    {
        Name = name;
    }
}

public class WorkerManager
{
    private readonly List<Worker> workers = new List<Worker>();
    private readonly object mainLock = new object();
    private int workerCount;
    private bool shouldTerminate = false;

    public void AddWorker(Worker w)
    {
        lock (mainLock)
        {
            workers.Add(w);
            workerCount++;
            Console.WriteLine($"Added worker: {w.Name}, Total: {workerCount}");
        }
    }

    // rolls back the worker thread creation .
    // - removes worker from workers , if present
    // - decrements worker count
    // - rechecks for termination , in case the existence of this worker was holding up termination
    private void AddWorkerFailed(Worker w)
    {
        lock (mainLock)
        {
            if (w != null)
            {
                workers.Remove(w);
                Console.WriteLine($"Removed worker: {w.Name}");
            }
            DecrementWorkerCount();
            TryTerminate();
        }
    }

    private void DecrementWorkerCount()
    {
        workerCount--;
        Console.WriteLine($"Worker count decremented, Total: {workerCount}");
    }

    private void TryTerminate()
    {
        if (workerCount == 0 && shouldTerminate)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Terminating system: No workers left.");
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Termination check: System still running.");
        }
    }

    public void RequestTermination()
    {
        lock (mainLock)
        {
            shouldTerminate = true;
            Console.WriteLine("Termination requested.");
            TryTerminate();
        }
    }

    // For demonstration: simulate worker failure
    public void SimulateWorkerAddAndFail(Worker w)
    {
        AddWorker(w);
        // Simulate failure right after adding
        AddWorkerFailed(w);
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        WorkerManager manager = new WorkerManager();

        Worker w1 = new Worker("Alice");
        Worker w2 = new Worker("Bob");

        manager.AddWorker(w1);
        manager.AddWorker(w2);

        // Simulate a worker failing to start
        Worker w3 = new Worker("Charlie");
        manager.SimulateWorkerAddAndFail(w3);

        manager.RequestTermination();

        // Remove remaining workers to allow termination
        manager.SimulateWorkerAddAndFail(w1);
        manager.SimulateWorkerAddAndFail(w2);
    }
}

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;

public class InsertFunctionalityTest {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            // Load the embedded driver
            Class.forName("org.h2.Driver");
            // Use an in-memory H2 database
            Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1");
            Statement stmt = conn.createStatement();

            // Create source table and insert some data
            stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE source_table (a INT, b INT)");
            stmt.execute("INSERT INTO source_table VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30)");

            // Create destination table
            stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE dest_table (x INT, y INT)");

            // Insert into dest_table using INSERT...SELECT with expressions
            stmt.execute("INSERT INTO dest_table (x, y) SELECT a+100, b*2 FROM source_table");

            // Query dest_table to check the inserts
            ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT x, y FROM dest_table ORDER BY x");

            System.out.println("Contents of dest_table after insert:");
            while(rs.next()) {
                int x = rs.getInt("x");
                int y = rs.getInt("y");
                System.out.println("x=" + x + ", y=" + y);
            }

            rs.close();
            stmt.close();
            conn.close();

        } catch (ClassNotFoundException | SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

{
    const string _STR = "INSERT INTO SimpleTable2(Value) SELECT Value FROM ";
    const int _NUM = 0;
    private SQLiteConnection conn;
    private SQLiteCommand statement;

    public TestClass()
    {
        conn = new SQLiteConnection("Data Source=:memory:;Version=3;New=True;");
        conn.Open();
        using (var cmd = conn.CreateCommand())
        {
            cmd.CommandText = $"CREATE TABLE {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE2} (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, Value INTEGER);";
            cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
        statement = new SQLiteCommand(conn);
    }

    public void TestInsert4()
    {

        statement.ExecuteNonQuery();

        statement.CommandText = $"SELECT Value FROM {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE2} JOIN {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE1} ON {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE2}.Value = {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE1}.Value";

    }

class DatabaseCreator
{
    public const string SIMPLE_TABLE1 = "SimpleTable1";
    public const string SIMPLE_TABLE2 = "SimpleTable2";

    public static void FillSimpleTable1(SQLiteConnection conn)
    {
        using (var cmd = conn.CreateCommand())
        {
            cmd.CommandText = $"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {SIMPLE_TABLE1} (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, Value INTEGER);";
            cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
            cmd.CommandText = $"INSERT INTO {SIMPLE_TABLE1} (Value) VALUES (42);";
            cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }

    public static void FillSimpleTable2(SQLiteConnection conn)
    {
        using (var cmd = conn.CreateCommand())
        {
            cmd.CommandText = $"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {SIMPLE_TABLE2} (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, Value INTEGER);";
            cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
            cmd.CommandText = "INSERT INTO " + SIMPLE_TABLE2 + " VALUES (42)";
            cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }

    public void SetUp() {

        stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE source_table (a INT, b INT)");
        stmt.execute("INSERT INTO source_table VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30)");

        // Create destination table
        stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE dest_table (x INT, y INT)");

        // Insert into dest_table using INSERT...SELECT with expressions
        stmt.execute("INSERT INTO dest_table (x, y) SELECT a+100, b*2 FROM source_table");

        // Query dest_table to check the inserts
        ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT x, y FROM dest_table ORDER BY x");

        System.out.println("Contents of dest_table after insert:");
        while(rs.next()) {
            int x = rs.getInt("x");
            int y = rs.getInt("y");
            System.out.println("x=" + x + ", y=" + y);
        }

        rs.close();
        stmt.close();

    }

    public void TestInsert4() {

        DatabaseCreator.FillSimpleTable1(conn);

        statement.CommandText = _STR + DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE1;
        statement.ExecuteNonQuery();

        statement.CommandText = $"SELECT Value FROM {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE2} JOIN {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE1} ON {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE2}.Value = {DatabaseCreator.SIMPLE_TABLE1}.Value";

import java.io.*;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class LocalIdMap {
    private static final String FILE_NAME = "idmap.dat";
    private Map<String, String> idMap;

    public LocalIdMap() {
        idMap = loadMap();
    }

    // writes one entry to the local id map on disk
    public void putEntry(String id, String entry) {
        idMap.put(id, entry);
        saveMap();
    }

    public String getEntry(String id) {
        return idMap.get(id);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Map<String, String> loadMap() {
        File file = new File(FILE_NAME);
        if (!file.exists()) {
            return new HashMap<>();
        }
        try (ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream(file))) {
            return (Map<String, String>) ois.readObject();
        } catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    private void saveMap() {
        try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(FILE_NAME))) {
            oos.writeObject(idMap);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        // Example of putting an entry into the local file
        idMap.putEntry("12345", "Sample Entry");
        System.out.println("Entry for 12345: " + idMap.getEntry("12345"));
    }
}

C#: ```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;

public class MapEntry
{
    public int RetainCount { get; set; }
    public string ObjectId { get; set; }
}

public class DiskPath
{
    public string Path { get; private set; }

    public DiskPath(string path)
    {
        Path = path;
    }

    public bool Exists()
    {
        return Directory.Exists(Path);
    }

    public void Mkdirs()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path);
    }
}

public static class ParseFileUtils
{
    public static void WriteJSONObjectToFile(FileInfo file, JObject json)
    {
        using (var writer = new StreamWriter(file.FullName))
        {
            writer.Write(json.ToString());
        }
    }
}

public class EntryMapHandler
{
    private const string _STR = "_STR";
    private readonly DiskPath diskPath;
    private readonly string _STR_VALUE = "_STR";

    public EntryMapHandler(string diskPath)
    {
        this.diskPath = new DiskPath(diskPath);
    }

    private bool IsLocalId(string localId)
    {
        // Placeholder for actual validation logic
        return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(localId);
    }

    public void PutMapEntry(string localId, MapEntry entry)
    {
        if (!IsLocalId(localId))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(_STR + localId + _STR);
        }

        var json = new JObject();
        try
        {
            json.Put(_STR, entry.RetainCount);
            if (entry.ObjectId != null)
            {
                json.Put(_STR, entry.ObjectId);
            }
        }
        catch (JsonException je)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(_STR, je);
        }

        var file = new FileInfo(Path.Combine(diskPath.Path, localId));
        if (!diskPath.Exists())
        {
            diskPath.Mkdirs();
        }
        try
        {
            ParseFileUtils.WriteJSONObjectToFile(file, json);
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
            // Handle the IOException as needed
        }
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        var handler = new EntryMapHandler("path/to/disk");
        var entry = new MapEntry { RetainCount = 5, ObjectId = "obj123" };
        handler.PutMapEntry("localId1", entry);
    }
}
