```java
import org.junit.Test;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;

public class LocalIdMapTest {
    @Test
    public void testPutAndGet() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        idMap.putEntry("12345", "Sample Entry");
        assertEquals("Sample Entry", idMap.getEntry("12345"));
    }

    @Test
    public void testPutAndGetNoFile() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        idMap.putEntry("12345", "Sample Entry");
        assertEquals("Sample Entry", idMap.getEntry("12345"));
    }

    @Test
    public void testPutAndGetWithIOException() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        try {
            idMap.putEntry("12345", "Sample Entry");
            fail("Expected IOException");
        } catch (IOException e) {
            // Ignore
        }
        assertEquals("", idMap.getEntry("12345"));
    }

    @Test
    public void testPutAndGetWithNullId() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        try {
            idMap.putEntry(null, "Sample Entry");
            fail("Expected exception");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Ignore
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void testPutAndGetWithNullEntry() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        try {
            idMap.putEntry("12345", null);
            fail("Expected exception");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Ignore
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void testPutAndGetWithEmptyFile() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        idMap.putEntry("12345", "Sample Entry");
        assertTrue(idMap.getEntry("12345").equals("Sample Entry"));
    }

    @Test
    public void testLoadFromEmptyFile() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        assertEquals(new HashMap<>(), idMap.loadMap());
    }

    @Test
    public void testSaveToEmptyFile() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
        idMap.saveMap();
        assertTrue(map.equals(idMap.loadMap()));
    }

    @Test
    public void testPutAndGetWithValidFile() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        mapFile(file);
        assertEquals("Sample Entry", idMap.getEntry("12345"));
    }

    @Test
    public void testPutAndGetWithValidFileAndNullEntry() throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        File file = new File("idmap.dat");
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete();
        }
        mapFile(file);
        try {
            idMap.putEntry("12345", null);
            fail("Expected exception");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Ignore
        }
    }

    private void mapFile(File file) throws IOException {
        LocalIdMap idMap = new LocalIdMap();
        try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(file))) {
            idMap.saveMap();
        }
        try (ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream(file))) {
            Map<String, String> map = (Map<String, String>) ois.readObject();
            idMap.idMap = map;
        } catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException e) {
            // Ignore
        }
    }
}
```

import org.xml.sax.Attributes;
import org.xml.sax.SAXException;
import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler;

class EndElementNotification {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Normally used with an XML parser, here we just demonstrate the method call
        MyHandler handler = new MyHandler();
        try {
            handler.endElement("namespaceURI", "localName", "elementName");
        } catch (SAXException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    static class MyHandler extends DefaultHandler {
        // Receive notification of the end of an element.
        @Override
        public void endElement(String uri, String localName, String qName) throws SAXException {
            System.out.println("End of element: " + qName);
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

namespace XmlEndElementDemo
{
    // Dummy base class to mock FireStartElem
    public class Base
    {
        public virtual void FireStartElem(string elemName)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("FireStartElem: " + elemName);
        }
    }

    // Mock SAXException for IOExceptions
    public class SAXException : Exception
    {
        public SAXException(Exception e) : base("SAXException", e) { }
    }

    // Dummy attribute list
    public class Attributes
    {
        private List<string> attrs = new List<string>();
        public int Length { get { return attrs.Count; } }

        public void Add(string attr)
        {
            attrs.Add(attr);
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            attrs.Clear();
        }
    }

    // Namespace context management mock
    public class PrefixMap
    {
        public void PopNamespaces(int level, object dummy)
        {
            // Mock behavior
        }
    }

    // Element context container
    public class ElemContext
    {
        public bool m_startTagOpen = false;
        public int m_currentElemDepth = 1;
        public string m_elementName = "element";
    }

    // Tracer stub
    public class Tracer { }

    public class EndElementMock : Base
    {
        private const int _NUM = 2;
        private const string _STR = "/>";

        private bool m_inEntityRef = false;
        private PrefixMap m_prefixMap = new PrefixMap();
        private ElemContext m_elemContext = new ElemContext();
        private Tracer m_tracer = new Tracer();
        private Attributes m_attributes = new Attributes();
        private bool m_spaceBeforeClose = false;
        private bool m_cdataTagOpen = false;
        private bool m_doIndent = true;
        private StringWriter m_writer = new StringWriter();

        public void EndElement(string namespaceURI, string localName, string name)
        {
            if (m_inEntityRef) return;
            m_prefixMap.PopNamespaces(m_elemContext.m_currentElemDepth, null);
            try
            {
                var writer = m_writer;
                if (m_elemContext.m_startTagOpen)
                {
                    if (m_tracer != null) base.FireStartElem(m_elemContext.m_elementName);
                    int nAttrs = m_attributes.Length;
                    if (nAttrs > _NUM)
                    {
                        ProcessAttributes(writer, nAttrs);
                        m_attributes.Clear();
                    }
                    if (m_spaceBeforeClose)
                        writer.Write(_STR);
                    else
                        writer.Write(_STR);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (m_cdataTagOpen)
                        CloseCDATA();
                    if (ShouldIndent())
                        Indent(m_elemContext.m_currentElemDepth - _NUM);
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                    writer.Write(name);
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                }
            }
            catch (IOException e)
            {
                throw new SAXException(e);
            }
            if (!m_elemContext.m_startTagOpen && m_doIndent)
            {
                // Extra behavior can go here
            }
        }

        // Dummy methods for completeness
        private void ProcessAttributes(TextWriter writer, int nAttrs)
        {
            writer.Write($"<!-- Processing {nAttrs} attributes -->");
        }
        private void CloseCDATA()
        {
            m_cdataTagOpen = false;
            m_writer.Write("<![CDATA[closed]]>");
        }
        private bool ShouldIndent()
        {
            return true;
        }
        private void Indent(int depth)
        {
            m_writer.Write(new string(' ', depth * 2));
        }
        public void ShowWriterContent()
        {
            Console.WriteLine(m_writer.ToString());
        }
        // To run as a standalone demo
        public static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var program = new EndElementMock();

            // Test with start tag open and more than _NUM attributes
            program.m_elemContext.m_startTagOpen = true;
            program.m_attributes.Add("attr1");
            program.m_attributes.Add("attr2");
            program.m_attributes.Add("attr3");
            program.EndElement("uri", "local", "elem1");
            program.ShowWriterContent();

            // Reset and test with start tag closed (not open)
            program = new EndElementMock();
            program.m_elemContext.m_startTagOpen = false;
            program.m_cdataTagOpen = true;
            program.EndElement("uri2", "local2", "elem2");
            program.ShowWriterContent();
        }
    }

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Main {
    // Removes the given element from the list
    public static <T> void removeFromList(List<T> list, T element) {
        list.remove(element);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example: leaves can be used for many-to-many relations
        List<String> leaves = new ArrayList<>();
        leaves.add("leaf1");
        leaves.add("leaf2");
        leaves.add("leaf3");

        System.out.println("Before removal: " + leaves);
        removeFromList(leaves, "leaf2");
        System.out.println("After removal: " + leaves);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace CatalogExample
{
    public class CatalogTreeLeaf
    {
        private string _name;

        public CatalogTreeLeaf(string name)
        {
            _name = name;
        }

        public string GetName()
        {
            return _name;
        }
    }

    public class Catalog
    {
        private List<CatalogTreeLeaf> _leaves = new List<CatalogTreeLeaf>();
        private int _NUM = 0; // You can set _NUM as needed

        public void AddLeaf(CatalogTreeLeaf leaf)
        {
            _leaves.Add(leaf);
        }

        // leaves can be used for many - to - many relations
        public void DeleteLeaves(string name)
        {
            for (int i = _NUM; i < _leaves.Count; i++)
            {
                CatalogTreeLeaf leaf = _leaves[i];
                if (name.Equals(leaf.GetName()))
                {
                    _leaves.RemoveAt(i);
                    i--; // Adjust index after removal
                }
            }
        }

        public void PrintLeaves()
        {
            foreach (var leaf in _leaves)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(leaf GetName());
            }
        }
    }

    public class Program
    {
        public static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Catalog catalog = new Catalog();
            catalog.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Apple"));
            catalog.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Banana"));
            catalog.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Apple"));
            catalog.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Cherry"));

            Console.WriteLine("Before deletion:");
            catalog.PrintLeaves();

            catalog.DeleteLeaves("Apple");

            Console.WriteLine("\nAfter deletion of 'Apple':");
            catalog.PrintLeaves();
        }
    }
}

```java
        for (int i = 'a'; i <= 'z'; i++) {

        removeFromList(leavesAll, "a");
        System.out.println("After removal:");

        // Test 5: Removes multiple occurrences of the same leaf
        List<String> leavesMulti = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
            leavesMulti.add(String.valueOf(i));
        }

        System.out.println("Before removal:");
        printLeaves(leavesMulti);
        removeFromList(leavesMulti, "B");
        System.out.println("After removal:");
        printLeaves(leavesMulti);

    }

    public static void printLeaves(List<String> leaves) {
        for (String leaf : leaves) {
            System.out.print(leaf + " ");
        }
        System.out.println();
    }
```

import java.util.BitSet;
public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BitSet vector = new BitSet();
        vector.set(0);
        vector.set(2);
        vector.set(4);
        System.out.println(bitSetToString(vector, 5));
    }

    /**
     * Returns a string representation of this vector.
     * Note that this string representation shows the bit of index 0 at the leftmost position.
     */
    public static String bitSetToString(BitSet bitSet, int length) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            sb.append(bitSet.get(i) ? "1" : "0");
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Text;

public class MyVector
{
    private int[] _data;
    private const int _NUM = 0;

    public MyVector(int[] data)
    {
        _data = data;
    }

    public int Size()
    {
        return _data.Length;
    }

    // Mock GetInt method, assuming each element is either 0 or 1 for bit representation
    public int GetInt(int index)
    {
        if (index >= 0 && index < _data.Length)
            return _data[index];
        return 0;
    }

    // returns a string representation of this vector
    // note: this string representation shows the bit of index 0 at the leftmost position.
    public override string ToString()
    {
        var s = new StringBuilder();
        int size = Size();
        for (int i = _NUM; i < size; i++)
        {
            s.Append(GetInt(i));
        }
        return s.ToString();
    }

    // For demonstration
    public static void Main()
    {
        int[] data = { 1, 0, 1, 1, 0 };
        MyVector vec = new MyVector(data);
        Console.WriteLine(vec.ToString()); // Output: 10110
    }
}

class UnitTestMyVector {
    public static void run() {

        assertEquals("01", vector.ToString());

import java.util.BitSet;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BitSet vector = new BitSet();
        vector.set(0);
        vector.set(2);
        vector.set(4);
        System.out.println(bitSetToString(vector, 5));
    }

    /**
     * Returns a string representation of this vector.
     * Note that this string representation shows the bit of index 0 at the leftmost position.
     */
    public static String bitSetToString(BitSet bitSet, int length) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            sb.append(bitSet.get(i) ? "1" : "0");
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

using System;

public class MyVector
{
    private int[] _data;
    private const int _NUM = 0;

    public MyVector(int[] data)
    {
        _data = data;
    }

    public int Size()
    {
        return _data.Length;
    }

    // Mock GetInt method, assuming each element is either 0 or 1 for bit representation
    public int GetInt(int index)
    {
        if (index >= 0 && index < _data.Length)
            return _data[index];
        return 0;
    }

    // returns a string representation of this vector
    // note: this string representation shows the bit of index 0 at the leftmost position.
    public override string ToString()
    {
        var s = new StringBuilder();
        int size = Size();
        for (int i = _NUM; i < size; i++)
        {
            s.Append(GetInt(i));
        }
        return s.ToString();
    }

    // For demonstration
    public static void Main()
    {
        int[] data = { 1, 0, 1, 1, 0 };
        MyVector vec = new MyVector(data);
        Console.WriteLine(vec.ToString()); // Output: 10110

        vector run = new UnitTestMyVector();
        vector.run();

        System.Console.ReadLine();
    }
}

public class UriValidator {

    /**
     * Checks whether the specified character is valid within a URI component.
     * The validation should be performed after escape encoding, or the component doesn't include escaped characters.
     * This validation is generous, not strict.
     *
     * @param ch         the character to check
     * @param component  the name of the component (not used in logic, but to match original intent)
     * @return           true if the character is valid, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isValidUriChar(char ch, String component) {
        // Allow unreserved characters: ALPHA / DIGIT / "-" / "." / "_" / "~"
        if ((ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') ||
                (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') ||
                (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') ||
                ch == '-' ||
                ch == '.' ||
                ch == '_' ||
                ch == '~') {
            return true;
        }
        // Allow sub-delims: "!" / "$" / "&" / "'" / "(" / ")"
        //                    "*" / "+" / "," / ";" / "="
        if ("!$&'()*+,;=".indexOf(ch) >= 0) {
            return true;
        }
        // Allow ':' and '@'
        if (ch == ':' || ch == '@') {
            return true;
        }
        // Allow percent (escaped encoding "%")
        if (ch == '%') {
            return true;
        }
        // Generous: allow '/' and '?', depending on component
        if (component != null) {
            if (component.equalsIgnoreCase("path") && ch == '/') {
                return true;
            }
            if (component.equalsIgnoreCase("query") && ch == '?') {
                return true;
            }
            if (component.equalsIgnoreCase("fragment") && (ch == '/' || ch == '?')) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Test examples
        char[] testChars = { 'A', 'z', '0', '-', '.', '_', '~', '!', '$', '&', '\'', '(', ')', '*', '+', ',', ';', '=', ':', '@', '%', '/', '?', ' ' };
        String[] components = { "path", "query", "fragment", "unknown" };

        for (String component : components) {
            System.out.println("Component: " + component);
            for (char ch : testChars) {
                boolean valid = isValidUriChar(ch, component);
                System.out.printf("  '%c' (%d): %s\n", ch, (int) ch, valid ? "valid" : "invalid");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
    }
}

public class UriValidatorExample
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        // Test examples
        char[] testChars = { 'A', 'z', '0', '-', '.', '_', '~', '!', '$', '&', '\'', '(', ')', '*', '+', ',', ';', '=', ':', '@', '%', '/', '?', ' ' };
        String[] components = { "path", "query", "fragment", "unknown" };

        for (String component : components) {
            Console.WriteLine("Component: " + component);
            for (char ch : testChars) {
                bool result = Validate(ch, component);
                Console.Write($"  '{ch}' ({(int)ch}): ");
                if (result)
                    Console.WriteLine("valid");
                else
                    Console.WriteLine("invalid");
            }
            Console.WriteLine();
        }
    }

import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;

public class BuildFinalBitmap {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int width = 400;
        int height = 400;
        BufferedImage finalBitmap = new BufferedImage(width, height, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);

        // Example: Suppose we have four pieces (sub-images)
        BufferedImage[] pieces = new BufferedImage[4];
        int pieceWidth = 200;
        int pieceHeight = 200;
        Color[] colors = { Color.RED, Color.GREEN, Color.BLUE, Color.ORANGE };
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            pieces[i] = new BufferedImage(pieceWidth, pieceHeight, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
            Graphics2D g = pieces[i].createGraphics();
            g.setColor(colors[i]);
            g.fillRect(0, 0, pieceWidth, pieceHeight);
            g.dispose();
        }

        // Build the final bitmap by drawing each piece
        Graphics2D g2d = finalBitmap.createGraphics();
        g2d.drawImage(pieces[0], 0, 0, null); // Top-left
        g2d.drawImage(pieces[1], 200, 0, null); // Top-right
        g2d.drawImage(pieces[2], 0, 200, null); // Bottom-left
        g2d.drawImage(pieces[3], 200, 200, null); // Bottom-right
        g2d.dispose();

        // Save the resulting bitmap to a file (for verification)
        try {
            javax.imageio.ImageIO.write(finalBitmap, "png", new java.io.File("final_bitmap.png"));
            System.out.println("Final bitmap created and saved as final_bitmap.png");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

import java.lang.Thread;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Create a shutdown hook
        Thread shutdownHook = new Thread(() -> System.out.println("Shutdown hook executed."));
        // Register the shutdown hook
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(shutdownHook);
        // Remove the previously registered shutdown hook
        boolean removed = Runtime.getRuntime().removeShutdownHook(shutdownHook);
        System.out.println("Shutdown hook removed: " + removed);
    }
}

C#:
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

namespace ShutdownHookExample
{
    public class RuntimePermission
    {
        private string name;
        public RuntimePermission(string name)
        {
            this.name = name;
        }
    }

    public class SecurityManager
    {
        public static SecurityManager Current { get; } = new SecurityManager();

        public void CheckPermission(RuntimePermission permission)
        {
            // For this example, permit all.
        }
    }

    public class ShutdownHookManager
    {
        private List<Thread> hooksList = new List<Thread>();
        private int VMState = 0;
        private const int _NUM = 3;

        public void RegisterShutdownHook(Thread hook)
        {
            lock (hooksList)
            {
                hooksList.Add(hook);
            }
        }

        // de-registers a previously-registered virtual-machine shutdown hook
        public bool RemoveShutdownHook(Thread hook)
        {
            SecurityManager sm = SecurityManager.Current;
            if (sm != null)
            {
                sm.CheckPermission(new RuntimePermission("shutdownHooks"));
            }
            if (hook == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(hook));
            if (VMState > _NUM)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException();
            }
            lock (hooksList)
            {
                return hooksList.Remove(hook);
            }
        }

        // Demo helper for this example
        public void PrintHooks()
        {
            lock (hooksList)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("Current hooks:");
                foreach (var h in hooksList)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(h.Name);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            ShutdownHookManager manager = new ShutdownHookManager();
            Thread hook1 = new Thread(() => Console.WriteLine("Hook 1"));
            hook1.Name = "Hook1";
            Thread hook2 = new Thread(() => Console.WriteLine("Hook 2"));
            hook2.Name = "Hook2";

            manager.RegisterShutdownHook(hook1);
            manager.RegisterShutdownHook(hook2);

            Console.WriteLine("Before removal:");
            shutdownhook();

            bool removed = manager.RemoveShutdownHook(hook1);
            Console.WriteLine($"Removed hook1: {removed}");

            Console.WriteLine("After removal:");
            shutdownhook();
        }
    }

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.concurrent.Callable;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.FutureTask;

public class ReadRequestDemo {

    // This Callable will read a line from System.in when called
    static class InputReader implements Callable<String> {
        @Override
        public String call() throws Exception {
            BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            return reader.readLine();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FutureTask<String> futureRead = null;
        Thread inputThread = null;
        
        System.out.println("Press enter (in another thread) to continue, or type 'quit' to exit.");
        boolean running = true;
        while (running) {
            // Run the request for the read input in the future (separate thread)
            futureRead = new FutureTask<>(new InputReader());
            inputThread = new Thread(futureRead);
            inputThread.setDaemon(true);
            inputThread.start();

            try {
                // Simulate another ongoing process that can be interrupted
                System.out.println("Main thread: Waiting for input request...");
                System.out.println("Type something and press enter in the input thread to continue.");

                String input = futureRead.get(); // This will block here for input

                if ("quit".equalsIgnoreCase(input)) {
                    System.out.println("Quit received. Exiting.");
                    running = false;
                } else {
                    System.out.println("You entered: " + input);
                }
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                System.out.println("Main thread interrupted!");
                running = false;
            } catch (ExecutionException e) {
                System.out.println("Input task failed: " + e.getMessage());
                running = false;
            }
        }
        System.out.println("Exited main loop.");
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        KeyboardInputCollector collector = new KeyboardInputCollector();
        Console.WriteLine("Press Enter to send an input request, or type 'quit' to exit.");

        while (true)
        {
            Console.Write("Type 'request' to get input: ");
            string cmd = Console.ReadLine();
            if (cmd == "quit")
            {
                break;
            }
            if (cmd == "request")
            {
                collector.RequestKeyboardInput();
                var inputs = collector.GetKeyboardInput();
                Console.WriteLine("Keyboard Inputs Collected:");
                foreach (var input in inputs)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(input);
                }
            }
        }

        collector.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine("Exiting.");
    }
}

C# Code:
```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;

public class KeyboardInputCollector
{
    private volatile bool m_KeyboardReadRequest = false;
    private StreamReader m_KeyboardStream;
    private List<string> m_KeyboardInput = new List<string>();
    private const int _NUM = 100; // milliseconds
    private Thread m_Thread;
    private volatile bool m_Running = true;

    public KeyboardInputCollector()
    {
        m_KeyboardStream = new StreamReader(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        m_Thread = new Thread(Run);
        m_Thread.IsBackground = true;
        m_Thread.Start();
    }

    public void RequestKeyboardInput()
    {
        m_KeyboardReadRequest = true;
        lock (this)
        {
            while (m_KeyboardReadRequest)
            {
                Monitor.Wait(this);
            }
        }
    }

    public List<string> GetKeyboardInput()
    {
        lock (m_KeyboardInput)
        {
            return new List<string>(m_KeyboardInput);
        }
    }

    public void Stop()
    {
        m_Running = false;
        m_KeyboardStream = null;
    }

    public void Run()
    {
        while (m_KeyboardStream != null && m_Running)
        {
            try
            {
                if (m_KeyboardReadRequest)
                {
                    string s = m_KeyboardStream.ReadLine();
                    lock (m_KeyboardInput)
                    {
                        m_KeyboardInput.Add(s);
                    }
                    m_KeyboardReadRequest = false;
                    lock (this)
                    {
                        Monitor.PulseAll(this);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Thread.Sleep(_NUM);
                }
            }
            catch (IOException)
            {
                // Handle IOException
            }
        }
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        KeyboardInputCollector collector = new KeyboardInputCollector();
        Console.WriteLine("Press Enter to send an input request, or type 'quit' to exit.");

        while (true)
        {
            Console.Write("Type 'request' to get input: ");
            string cmd = Console.ReadLine();
            if (cmd == "quit")
            {
                break;
            }
            if (cmd == "request")
            {
                collector.RequestKeyboardInput();
                var inputs = collector.GetKeyboardInput();
                Console.WriteLine("Keyboard Inputs Collected:");
                foreach (var input in inputs)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(input);
                }
            }
        }

        collector.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine("Exiting.");
    }
}
```

import java.util.Arrays;

public class ScrollBounder {
    private int scrollPosition;
    private int minScroll;
    private int maxScroll;

    public ScrollBounder(int scrollPosition, int minScroll, int maxScroll) {
        this.scrollPosition = scrollPosition;
        this.minScroll = minScroll;
        this.maxScroll = maxScroll;
    }

    // Bounds the current scroll if necessary
    public void boundScroll() {
        if (scrollPosition < minScroll) {
            scrollPosition = minScroll;
        } else if (scrollPosition > maxScroll) {
            scrollPosition = maxScroll;
        }
    }

    public int getScrollPosition() {
        return scrollPosition;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ScrollBounder scrollBounder = new ScrollBounder(150, 0, 100);
        System.out.println("Before bounding: " + scrollBounder.getScrollPosition());
        scrollBounder.boundScroll();
        System.out.println("After bounding: " + scrollBounder.getScrollPosition());

        Arrays.asList(-50, 10, 160, -1).forEach(value -> {
            int original = value;
            scrollBounder.setScrollPosition(value);
            scrollBounder.boundScroll();
            System.out.print("Original: " + original);
            System.out.print(", Expected: ");
            if (value < 0) System.out.println("0");
            else if (value > 100) System.out.println("100");
            else System.out.println(value);
            System.out.print(", Actual: ");
            System.out.println(scrollBounder.getScrollPosition());
            System.out.println();
        });
    }

    private void setScrollPosition(int value) {
        scrollPosition = value;
    }
}

public class ScrollManager {
    public float stackScroll = 0.0f;
    public float minScroll = 0.0f;
    public float maxScroll = 100.0f;

    // Gets the current stack scroll value
    public float getStackScroll() {
        return stackScroll;
    }

    // Sets the stack scroll value
    public void setStackScroll(float value) {
        stackScroll = value;
    }

    // Returns the bounded scroll value
    public float getBoundedStackScroll(float value) {
        if (value < minScroll) return minScroll;
        if (value > maxScroll) return maxScroll;
        return value;
    }

    // bounds the current scroll if necessary
    public bool boundScroll() {
        float curScroll = stackScroll;
        float newScroll = getBoundedStackScroll(curScroll);
        if (newScroll.CompareTo(curScroll) != 0)
        {
            setStackScroll(newScroll);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

{

    {

import java.util.*;

public class Evaluation {

    private double sum;
    private int count;

    public Evaluation() {
        this.sum = 0;
        this.count = 0;
    }

    // Adds the statistics from another Evaluation object into this one
    // Does not check for compatibility
    public void add(Evaluation e) {
        this.sum += e.sum;
        this.count += e.count;
    }

    public void addValue(double value) {
        this.sum += value;
        this.count++;
    }

    public double getAverage() {
        return count == 0 ? 0 : sum / count;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Sum: " + sum + ", Count: " + count + ", Average: " + getAverage();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Evaluation eval1 = new Evaluation();
        eval1.addValue(80);
        eval1.addValue(90);

        Evaluation eval2 = new Evaluation();
        eval2.addValue(70);
        eval2.addValue(85);

        System.out.println("Before adding:");
        System.out.println("eval1: " + eval1);
        System.out.println("eval2: " + eval2);

        // Adds the statistics of eval2 to eval1
        eval1.add(eval2);

        System.out.println("After adding:");
        System.out.println("eval1: " + eval1);
    }
}

public class EvaluationAggregator {
    public interface AggregateableEvaluation {
        AggregateableEvaluation Aggregate(Evaluation evaluation);
    }

    public class Evaluation {
        public int m_MissingClass = 0;
        public int m_WithClass = 0;
        public double[][] m_ConfusionMatrix;
        public double[] m_ClassPriors;
        public double m_ClassPriorsSum = 0.0;

        private int incorrect = 0;
        private int correct = 0;
        private int unclassified = 0;

        public Evaluation(int numClasses) {
            m_ConfusionMatrix = new double[numClasses][];
            for (int i = 0; i < numClasses; i++) {
                m_ConfusionMatrix[i] = new double[numClasses];
            }
            m_ClassPriors = new double[numClasses];
        }

        public void SetStats(int correct, int incorrect, int unclassified, int missingClass, int withClass, double[][] confusionMatrix, double[] classPriors, double classPriorsSum) {
            this.correct = correct;
            this.incorrect = incorrect;
            this.unclassified = unclassified;
            this.m_MissingClass = missingClass;
            this.m_WithClass = withClass;

            if (confusionMatrix != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < m_ConfusionMatrix.Length; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m_ConfusionMatrix.Length; j++) {
                        m_ConfusionMatrix[i][j] = confusionMatrix[i][j];
                    }
                }
            }

            if (classPriors != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < m_ClassPriors.Length; i++) {
                    m_ClassPriors[i] = classPriors[i];
                }
            }
            m_ClassPriorsSum = classPriorsSum;
        }

        public int Incorrect() => incorrect;

        public int Correct() => correct;

        public int Unclassified() => unclassified;

        public double[][] ConfusionMatrix() {
            if (m_ConfusionMatrix == null) return null;
            double[][] copy = new double[m_ConfusionMatrix.Length][];
            for (int i = 0; i < m-ConfusionMatrix.Length; i++) {
                copy[i] = new double[m-ConfusionMatrix[i].Length];
                for (int j = 0; j < m-ConfusionMatrix[i].Length; j++) {
                    copy[i][j] = m_ConfusionMatrix[i][j];
                }
            }
            return copy;
        }
    }

    public class MyAggregateableEvaluation : Evaluation, AggregateableEvaluation {
        private int m_Incorrect = 0;
        private int m_Correct = 0;
        private int m_Unclassified = 0;
        private int m_MissingClass = 0;
        private int m_WithClass = 0;

        public double[][] m_ConfusionMatrix;
        public double[] m_ClassPriors;
        public double m_ClassPriorsSum = 0.0;

        public MyAggregateableEvaluation(int numClasses) : base(numClasses) {
            // ...
        }

        public override AggregateableEvaluation Aggregate(Evaluation evaluation) {
            // ...
        }
    }

            Evaluation eval1 = new Evaluation();
            eval1.addValue(80);
            eval1.addValue(90);

            Evaluation eval2 = new Evaluation();
            eval2.addValue(70);
            eval2.addValue(85);

            // Adds the statistics of eval2 to eval1
            eval1.add(eval2);

            System.out.println("After adding:");
            System.out.println("eval1: " + eval1);

```java
public class RecoverPointScanner {

    // Mock method representing checking if all volumes are visible at all sites
    private boolean areAllVolumesVisible(List<String> sites, List<String> volumes) {
        // In a real implementation, this would check each site for each volume
        // For demonstration, let's assume all volumes become visible after 3 attempts
        return true;
    }

    public void scanAllSitesUntilVolumesVisible(List<String> sites, List<String> volumes) {
        System.out.println("Starting scan of all sites for RecoverPoint protected volumes...");

        while (!areAllVolumesVisible(sites, volumes)) {
            System.out.println("Not all volumes are visible. Retrying in 2 seconds...");
            try {
                Thread.sleep(2000);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                System.out.println("Scan interrupted.");
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                return;
            }
        }

        System.out.println("All volumes are now visible at all sites!");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        RecoverPointScanner scanner = new RecoverPointScanner();
        scanner.scanAllSitesUntilVolumesVisible(new ArrayList<>(), new ArrayList<>());
    }
}
```

import javax.swing.*;
import java.awt.*;

public class OutlineViewUpdater {

    private JFrame frame;
    private JLabel outlineViewLabel;

    public OutlineViewUpdater() {
        frame = new JFrame("Outline View");
        outlineViewLabel = new JLabel();
        outlineViewLabel.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, 18));
        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
        frame.setSize(300, 150);
        frame.getContentPane().setLayout(new BorderLayout());
        frame.getContentPane().add(outlineViewLabel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
    }

    public void updateOutlineView(String name, String value) {
        outlineViewLabel.setText("<html><b>" + name + ":</b> " + value + "</html>");
    }

    public void show() {
        frame.setVisible(true);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example usage
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(new Runnable() {
            public void run() {
                OutlineViewUpdater updater = new OutlineViewUpdater();
                updater.updateOutlineView("Item Name", "Sample Value");
                updater.show();
            }
        });
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace OutlineViewUpdater
{
    // Dummy classes to support the program
    public class JsonObject
    {
        public string Data { get; set; }
    }

    public class IndicatorViewState
    {
        public object InputElement { get; }
        public JsonObject JsonObject { get; }
        public string IndicatorType { get; }
        public string SecuritySpec { get; }

        public IndicatorViewState(object inputElement, JsonObject jsonObject, string securitySpec, IndicatorViewState oldState)
        {
            InputElement = inputElement;
            JsonObject = jsonObject;
            IndicatorType = jsonObject?.Data ?? "DefaultIndicator";
            SecuritySpec = securitySpec;
        }
    }

    public class TreeViewer
    {
        private object sorter = null;
        private object input = null;

        public void SetInput(JsonObject obj)
        {
            input = obj;
            Console.WriteLine("TreeViewer input set: " + (obj != null ? obj.Data : "null"));
        }

        public object GetSorter()
        {
            return sorter;
        }

        public void SetSorter(object newSorter)
        {
            sorter = newSorter;
        }
    }

    public static class DroidsafePluginUtilities
    {
        public static JsonObject ParseIndicatorFile(object inputElement)
        {
            // Dummy parse result
            if (inputElement != null)
                return new JsonObject { Data = inputElement.ToString() + "_Json" };
            else
                return null;
        }
    }

    public class OutlineView
    {
        private object fInputElement;
        private object fParentComposite;
        private readonly Dictionary<object, IndicatorViewState> fStateMap = new Dictionary<object, IndicatorViewState>();
        private readonly HashSet<object> fFilesToReoad = new HashSet<object>();
        private IndicatorViewState fState;
        private TreeViewer fTreeViewer = new TreeViewer();
        private const string DEFAULT_PART_NAME = "DefaultPart";
        private const int PAGE_VIEWER = 1;

        private string GetSecuritySpec() => "SecuritySpec";
        private string GetSortByField() => "FieldName";
        private void SetPartName(string name) => Console.WriteLine("Part name set: " + name);
        private void ShowPage(int page) => Console.WriteLine("Page shown: " + page);
        private void SortByField(string fieldName)
        {
            fTreeViewer.SetSorter(fieldName);
            Console.WriteLine($"TreeViewer sorted by: {fieldName}");
        }

        // The code snippet to be included:
        // update the content of the outline view
        public void UpdateView()
        {
            if (fInputElement != null && fParentComposite != null)
            {
                fStateMap.TryGetValue(fInputElement, out IndicatorViewState oldState);
                bool reload = fFilesToReoad.Contains(fInputElement);
                if (reload || oldState == null)
                {
                    JsonObject jsonObject = DroidsafePluginUtilities.ParseIndicatorFile(fInputElement);
                    if (jsonObject == null)
                        return;
                    fFilesToReoad.Remove(fInputElement);
                    fState = new IndicatorViewState(fInputElement, jsonObject, GetSecuritySpec(), oldState);
                    fStateMap[fInputElement] = fState;
                }
                else
                {
                    fState = oldState;
                }
                SetPartName(fState.IndicatorType);
                ShowPage(PAGE_VIEWER);
                fTreeViewer.SetInput(fState.JsonObject);
                if (fTreeViewer.GetSorter() == null)
                    SortByField(GetSortByField());
            }
            else
            {
                SetPartName(DEFAULT_PART_NAME);
            }
        }

        // Methods to set dummy input values for the test
        public void SetInputElement(object element)
        {
            fInputElement = element;
        }

        public void SetParentComposite(object parent)
        {
            fParentComposite = parent;
        }

        public void AddToFilesToReload(object element)
        {
            fFilesToReoad.Add(element);
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            OutlineView view = new OutlineView();

            // Case 1: Both input element and parent exist, needs reload
            object element = "File1";
            object parent = new object();
            view.SetInputElement(element);
            view.SetParentComposite(parent);
            view.AddToFilesToReload(element);

            view.UpdateView();

            // Case 2: Second call, should not reload as filesToReload is cleared
            view.UpdateView();

            // Case 3: No parent composite
            view.SetParentComposite(null);
            view.UpdateView();
        }
    }

}

import javax.swing.*;
import java.awt.*;

public class ImagePainter extends JPanel {

    private Image image;

    public ImagePainter(Image image) {
        this.image = image;
    }

    // paints the image on the window.
    @Override
    protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
        super.paintComponent(g);
        if (image != null) {
            g.drawImage(image, 0, 0, this.getWidth(), this.getHeight(), this);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
            JFrame frame = new JFrame("Image Painter");
            frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
            // You can replace the following line with your own image path.
            Image image = Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().createImage("example.jpg");
            ImagePainter panel = new ImagePainter(image);
            frame.add(panel);
            frame.setSize(400, 300);
            frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
            frame.setVisible(true);
        });
    }
}

C#: using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Threading;
using System.Windows.Forms;

public class ImageForm : Form
{
    private Image image;
    private bool paintCalled = false;
    private const int _NUM = 10;
    private const bool _BOOL = true;

    public ImageForm()
    {
        // Load a sample image. Change the path to your own image if needed.
        image = new Bitmap(100, 100);
        using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(image))
        {
            g.Clear(Color.Blue);
            g.FillEllipse(Brushes.Red, 10, 10, 80, 80);
        }
        this.Width = 200;
        this.Height = 200;
    }

    protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
    {
        OnPaint(e.Graphics);
    }

    public override void OnPaint(Graphics g)
    {
        g.DrawImage(image, _NUM, _NUM);
        if (!paintCalled)
        {
            paintCalled = _BOOL;
            lock (this)
            {
                Monitor.PulseAll(this);
            }
        }
    }

    [STAThread]
    public static void Main()
    {
        Application.Run(new ImageForm());
    }
}

```java
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public class EventConnector {
    private Set<String> availableEvents;

    public EventConnector() {
        availableEvents = new HashSet<>();
        // Example: Initially accept connections for these events
        availableEvents.add("onClick");
        availableEvents.add("onHover");
        availableEvents.add("onConnect");
    }

    /**
     * Returns true if, at this time, the object will accept a connection with respect to the named event.
     */
    public boolean acceptsConnection(String eventName) {
        return availableEvents.contains(eventName);
    }
}

public class EventConnectorTests {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        EventConnector connector = new EventConnector();

        System.out.println(connector.acceptsConnection("onClick")); // true
        System.out.println(connector.acceptsConnection("onHover")); // true
        System.out.println(connector.acceptsConnection("onSubmit")); // false
        System.out.println(connector.acceptsConnection("onDisconnect")); // false
    }
}
```

```java
public class FilenameChecker {
    public static boolean isPrefixed(String filename) {
        return filename != null && filename.contains(":");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String test1 = "example:file.txt";
        String test2 = "file.txt";
        System.out.println(isPrefixed(test1)); // true
        System.out.println(isPrefixed(test2)); // false

        System.out.println(isPrefixed("xml:file")); // true
        System.out.println(isPrefixed("file")); // false

        System.out.println(isPrefixed(null)); // null
        System.out.println(isPrefixed("")); // false

        System.out.println(isPrefixed("example:")); // true
        System.out.println(isPrefixed(":file")); // true
    }
}

public class AttributeHelper {
    private string name;
    private const string _STR = ":";
    private const int _NUM = 0;

    public AttributeHelper(string name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public bool IsPrefixed() {
        return name.IndexOf(_STR) >= _NUM;
    }
}

class Program {
    static void Main() {
        AttributeHelper attr1 = new AttributeHelper("xml:lang");
        AttributeHelper attr2 = new AttributeHelper("lang");

        Console.WriteLine(attr1.IsPrefixed()); // True
        Console.WriteLine(attr2.IsPrefixed()); // False

        Console.WriteLine(attr1.IsPrefixed());
        Console.WriteLine(attr2.IsPrefixed());

        Console.WriteLine(AttributeHelper.IsPrefixed(null)); // null
        Console.WriteLine(AttributeHelper.IsPrefixed("")); // false

        Console.WriteLine(AttributeHelper.IsPrefixed("example:")); // True
        Console.WriteLine(AttributeHelper.IsPrefixed(":file")); // True
    }
}
```

```java
public class Main {

        Connection connection = new Connection();

        // Release the connection to be checked (non-shard-specific)
        ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(connection);
    }
}

class Connection {
    // Dummy connection class for illustration
    public void close() {
        System.out.println("Connection closed.");
    }
}

class ConnectionManager {
    // Releases a non-shard-specific connection
    public static void releaseConnection(Connection connection) {
        // Assume this releases the connection for checking by the connection pool
        System.out.println("Releasing a non-shard-specific connection.");
        connection.close();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using MySql.Data.MySqlClient;

public class ConnectionManager
{
    // release a non - shard - specific connection .
    public void ReleaseAnyConnection(MySqlConnection connection)
    {
        try
        {
            connection.Close();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Error releasing connection", ex);
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        string connectionString = "server=localhost;user id=root;password=your_password;database=test";
        MySqlConnection connection = new MySqlConnection(connectionString);
        try
        {
            connection.Open();
            Console.WriteLine("Connection opened successfully.");

            ConnectionManager manager = new ConnectionManager();
            manager.ReleaseAnyConnection(connection);
            Console.WriteLine("Connection released successfully.");
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Error: {e.Message}");
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class MainTest {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Test 1: Release a connection that is already closed
        Connection connection = new Connection();
        ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(connection);
        
        // Verify that the connection was released successfully
        
        // Test 2: Release an existing non-shard-specific connection
        Connection existingConnection = new Connection();
        ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(existingConnection);

        // Verify that the existing connection was released successfully

        // Test 3: Attempt to release a closed connection
        Connection closedConnection = null;
        try {
            ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(closedConnection);
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {
            System.out.println("Error: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        // Verify that the NullPointerException was thrown
        
        // Test 4: Release multiple non-shard-specific connections in a row
        Connection connection2 = new Connection();
        ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(connection2);
        
        try {
            ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(connection);
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {
            System.out.println("Error: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        // Verify that the existing connection was released successfully

        // Test 5: Release a non-shard-specific connection and then attempt to release it again
        Connection connection3 = new Connection();
        try {
            ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(connection3);
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {
            System.out.println("Error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
        
        try {
            ConnectionManager.releaseConnection(connection3);
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {
            System.out.println("Error: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        // Verify that the NullPointerException was thrown
    }
```

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

class Action {
    private String name;

    public Action(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Action: " + name;
    }
}

class QuickActionView {
    private List<Action> actions = new ArrayList<>();

    public void addIntentActions(List<Action> intentActions) {
        // adds a collection of actions to the quickactionview
        actions.addAll(intentActions);
    }

    public void printActions() {
        for (Action action : actions) {
            System.out.println(action);
        }
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        QuickActionView quickActionView = new QuickActionView();
        List<Action> newActions = new ArrayList<>();
        newActions.add(new Action("Open"));
        newActions.add(new Action("Edit"));
        newActions.add(new Action("Share"));

        // adds an actions to the end of the given intent.
        quickActionView.addIntentActions(newActions);

        quickActionView.printActions();
    }
}

class QuickActionViewCSharp {
    private List<Action> mActions = new List<Action>();

    public QuickActionViewCSharp AddActions(IEnumerable<Action> actions)
    {
        // adds a collection of actions to the quickactionview
        foreach (var action in actions)
        {
            mActions.Add(action);
        }
        return this;
    }

    public void Show()
    {
        //Show that all actions are executed when the view is shown.
        Console.WriteLine("QuickActionView is now shown.");
        for (int i = 0; i < mActions.Count; i++)
        {
            var action = mActions[i];
            System.Console.Write($"Action {i+1}: ");
            action.Execute();
            System.Console.Write("\n");
        }
    }
}

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;

public class StreamCopier {

    public interface ProgressListener {
        /**
         * Called every time progress is made.
         * @param bytesCopied Number of bytes copied so far.
         * @param shouldStop  Set this boolean[0] to true to interrupt copying.
         */
        void onProgress(long bytesCopied, boolean[] shouldStop);
    }

    /**
     * Copies from inputStream to outputStream, firing progress events by listener, and can be interrupted by listener.
     * @param inputStream  Source stream
     * @param outputStream Destination stream
     * @param listener     Progress listener, can interrupt the process
     * @throws IOException
     */
    public static void copyStream(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream, ProgressListener listener)
            throws IOException {
        byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
        int read;
        long totalCopied = 0;
        boolean[] shouldStop = new boolean[] {false};

        while ((read = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
            outputStream.write(buffer, 0, read);
            totalCopied += read;

            // Notify the listener
            if (listener != null) {
                shouldStop[0] = false;
                listener.onProgress(totalCopied, shouldStop);
                if (shouldStop[0]) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        outputStream.flush();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        byte[] inputBytes = new byte[10000];
        for (int i = 0; i < inputBytes.length; i++) {
            inputBytes[i] = (byte)(i % 256);
        }

        ByteArrayInputStream bais = new ByteArrayInputStream(inputBytes);
        ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

        ProgressListener listener = new ProgressListener() {
            @Override
            public void onProgress(long bytesCopied, boolean[] shouldStop) {
                System.out.println("Copied: " + bytesCopied + " bytes");
                // Interrupt if more than 3000 bytes copied
                if (bytesCopied >= 3000) {
                    System.out.println("Interrupting copying...");
                    shouldStop[0] = true;
                }
            }
        };

        copyStream(bais, baos, listener);

        System.out.println("Total copied: " + baos.size() + " bytes");
    }
}

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;

public class StreamCopier
{
    public static bool CopyStream(Stream inputStream, Stream outputStream, CopyListener listener, int bufferSize)
    {
        int current = 0;
        int total = (int)inputStream.Length; // Use Length instead of available()

        if (total <= 0)
        {
            total = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB or any default
        }

        byte[] bytes = new byte[bufferSize];
        int count;

        if (ShouldStopLoading(listener, current, total))
            return true;

        while ((count = inputStream.Read(bytes, 0, bufferSize)) != 0)
        {
            outputStream.Write(bytes, 0, count);
            current += count;
            listener.OnProgress(current, total);
            if (ShouldStopLoading(listener, current, total))
                return true;
        }
        outputStream.Flush();
        return true;
    }

    private static bool ShouldStopLoading(CopyListener listener, int current, int total)
    {
        return listener != null && listener.ShouldStop(current, total);
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        byte[] sourceData = new byte[2048];
        for (int i = 0; i < sourceData.Length; i++)
            sourceData[i] = (byte)(i % 256);

        using (MemoryStream inputStream = new MemoryStream(sourceData))
        using (MemoryStream outputStream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            CopyListener listener = new ProgressCopyListener();
            int bufferSize = 256;
            StreamCopier.CopyStream(inputStream, outputStream, listener, bufferSize);

            Console.WriteLine("Copy completed. Bytes in output: " + outputStream.Length);
        }
    }
}

public class ProgressCopyListener : CopyListener
{
    public bool ShouldStop(int current, int total)
    {
        // Here we don't stop, just for demo purposes.
        return false;
    }

    public void OnProgress(int current, int total)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Progress: {current}/{total} bytes copied.");
    }
}

public class StreamCopier {

    public interface ProgressListener {
        /**
         * Called every time progress is made.
         * @param bytesCopied Number of bytes copied so far.
         * @param shouldStop  Set this boolean[0] to true to interrupt copying.
         */
        void onProgress(long bytesCopied, boolean[] shouldStop);
    }

    /**
     * Copies from inputStream to outputStream, firing progress events by listener, and can be interrupted by listener.
     * @param inputStream  Source stream
     * @param outputStream Destination stream
     * @param listener     Progress listener, can interrupt the process
     * @throws IOException
     */
    public static void copyStream(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream, ProgressListener listener)
            throws IOException {

        int read;
        long totalCopied = 0;
        boolean[] shouldStop = new boolean[] {false};

        while ((read = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
            outputStream.write(buffer, 0, read);
            totalCopied += read;

            // Notify the listener
            if (listener != null) {
                shouldStop[0] = false;
                listener.onProgress(totalCopied, shouldStop);
                if (shouldStop[0]) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        outputStream.flush();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        byte[] inputBytes = new byte[10000];
        for (int i = 0; i < inputBytes.length; i++) {
            inputBytes[i] = (byte)(i % 256);
        }

        ByteArrayInputStream bais = new ByteArrayInputStream(inputBytes);
        ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

        ProgressListener listener = new ProgressListener() {
            @Override
            public void onProgress(long bytesCopied, boolean[] shouldStop) {
                System.out.println("Copied: " + bytesCopied + " bytes");
                // Interrupt if more than 3000 bytes copied
                if (bytesCopied >= 3001) {
                    System.out.println("Interrupting copying...");
                    shouldStop[0] = true;
                }
            }
        };

        StreamCopier.copyStream(bais, baos, listener);

        assertEquals(10000, baos.size());

        // Test that the copy stream was interrupted correctly
        ByteArrayInputStream bais2 = new ByteArrayInputStream(new byte[3001]);
        ByteArrayOutputStream baos2 = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

```java
        double angleRadians = calculator.calculateAngle(value);
        assertEquals(30.0, angleRadians, 0.00001); // tolerance for float comparison
    }

    @Test
    public void testAngleCalculator_degrees() {

        AngleCalculator calculator = new AngleCalculator();
        double angleDegrees = calculator.toDegrees(calculator.calculateAngle(value));

        assertEquals(30.0, angleDegrees, 0.00001); // tolerance for float comparison
    }

    @Test
    public void testAngleCalculator_infinite_value() {
        double value = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY; // Example infinite value
        AngleCalculator calculator = new AngleCalculator();
        double angleRadians = calculator.calculateAngle(value);
        assertEquals(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, angleRadians, 0.00001); // tolerance for float comparison
    }

    @Test
    public void testAngleCalculator_negative_value() {
        double value = -0.5; // Example negative value
        AngleCalculator calculator = new AngleCalculator();
        double angleRadians = calculator.calculateAngle(value);
        assertEquals(180.0, Math.toDegrees(angleRadians), 0.00001); // tolerance for float comparison
    }

    @Test
    public void testAngleCalculator_zero_value() {
        double value = 0.0; // Example zero value
        AngleCalculator calculator = new AngleCalculator();
        double angleRadians = calculator.calculateAngle(value);
        assertEquals(0.0, Math.toDegrees(angleRadians), 0.00001); // tolerance for float comparison
    }
}

public class AngleCalculator {

    public static double calculateAngle(double value) {
        return Math.asin(value);
    }

    private static double toDegrees(double radians) {
        return radians * 180 / Math.PI;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        double value = 0.5; // Example value
        System.out.println("For value: " + value);
        System.out.println("Angle in radians: " + calculateAngle(value));
        System.out.println("Angle in degrees: " + toDegrees(calculateAngle(value)));
    }
}
```

```csharp
class Data {
    private float[] yValues;

    public Data(float[] yValues) {
        this.yValues = yValues;
    }

    public float GetYValueSum() {
        float sum = 0;
        foreach (var v in yValues) {
            sum += v;
        }
        return sum;
    }
}

class AngleCalculator {
    private Data mData;
    private const float _NUM = 360f; // Angle in degrees for a full circle

    public AngleCalculator(Data data) {
        mData = data;
    }

    private float CalcAngle(float value) {
        return value / mData.GetYValueSum() * _NUM;
    }

    public void RunExample() {
        float value = 25f;
        float angle = CalcAngle(value);
        Console.WriteLine($"Angle for value {value} is: {angle} degrees");
    }
}

class Program {
    static void Main(string[] args) {
        float[] yValues = new float[] {10f, 20f, 30f, 40f};
        Data data = new Data(yValues);
        AngleCalculator calculator = new AngleCalculator(data);
        calculator.RunExample();
    }
}
```

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;

public class BufferPool {
    private final int maxPoolSize;
    private final Deque<byte[]> pool;

    public BufferPool(int maxPoolSize) {
        this.maxPoolSize = maxPoolSize;
        this.pool = new ArrayDeque<>();
    }

    // Returns a buffer to the pool, throwing away old buffers if the pool would exceed its allotted size.
    public synchronized void returnBuffer(byte[] buffer) {
        if (pool.size() >= maxPoolSize) {
            pool.pollFirst(); // throw away the oldest buffer
        }
        pool.offerLast(buffer); // return the buffer to the pool
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BufferPool bufferPool = new BufferPool(3);

        byte[] buffer1 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer2 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer3 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer4 = new byte[1024];

        bufferPool.returnBuffer(buffer1);
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(buffer2);
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(buffer3);

        System.out.println("Pool size after adding 3 buffers: " + bufferPool.pool.size()); // Should be 3

        // This will remove the oldest (buffer1) and add buffer4
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(buffer4);

        System.out.println("Pool size after adding 4th buffer (max size 3): " + bufferPool.pool.size()); // Still 3
    }
}

import System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

public class BufferPool
{
    private readonly int mSizeLimit;
    private readonly List<byte[]> mBuffersByLastUse = new List<byte[]>();
    private readonly List<byte[]> mBuffersBySize = new List<byte[]>();
    private readonly IComparer<byte[]> BUF_COMPARATOR = new BufferSizeComparer();
    private readonly object _lock = new object();
    private int mCurrentSize = 0;
    private const int _NUM = 1;

    public BufferPool(int sizeLimit)
    {
        mSizeLimit = sizeLimit;
    }

    // returns a buffer to the pool , throwing away old buffers if the pool would exceed its allotted size .
    public void ReturnBuf(byte[] buf)
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            if (buf == null || buf.Length > mSizeLimit)
            {
                return;
            }
            mBuffersByLastUse.Add(buf);
            int pos = mBuffersBySize.BinarySearch(buf, BUF_COMPARATOR);
            if (pos < _NUM)
            {
                pos = -pos - _NUM;
            }
            mBuffersBySize.Insert(pos, buf);
            mCurrentSize += buf.Length;
            Trim();
        }
    }

    private void Trim()
    {
        while (mCurrentSize > mSizeLimit && mBuffersByLastUse.Count > 0)
        {
            byte[] oldest = mBuffersByLastUse[0];
            mBuffersByLastUse.RemoveAt(0);
            mBuffersBySize.Remove(oldest);
            mCurrentSize -= oldest.Length;
        }
    }

    public byte[] GetBuf(int size)
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < mBuffersBySize.Count; i++)
            {
                if (mBuffersBySize[i].Length >= size)
                {
                    byte[] buf = mBuffersBySize[i];
                    mBuffersByLastUse.Remove(buf);
                    mBuffersBySize.RemoveAt(i);
                    mCurrentSize -= buf.Length;
                    return buf;
                }
            }
        }
        return new byte[size];
    }

    private void mBuffersByByLastUseRemove(byte[] buf)
    {
        mBuffersByLastUse.Remove(buf);
    }
}

public class BufferSizeComparer : IComparer<byte[]>
{
    public int Compare(byte[] x, byte[] y)
    {
        if (x == null || y == null)
            return 0;
        return x.Length.CompareTo(y.Length);
    }
}

class TestBufferPool
{
    private static int numPassed = 0;

    [Test]
    public void ReturnsBufferToPool()
    {
        BufferPool pool = new BufferPool(3);

        byte[] buffer1 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer2 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer3 = new byte[1024];

        pool.returnBuffer(buffer1);
        pool.returnBuffer(buffer2);
        pool.returnBuffer(buffer3);

        Assert.AreEqual(3, pool.pool.size());

        // This will remove the oldest (buffer1) and add buffer4
        pool.returnBuffer(new byte[1000]);

        Assert.AreEqual(3, pool.pool.size());
    }

    [Test]
    public void ThrowsAwayOldBuffersWhenPoolExceedsSize()
    {
        BufferPool pool = new BufferPool(3);

        byte[] buffer1 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer2 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer3 = new byte[1024];

        pool.returnBuffer(buffer1);
        pool.returnBuffer(buffer2);
        pool.returnBuffer(buffer3);

        Assert.AreEqual(3, pool.pool.size());

        // This will remove the oldest (buffer1) and add buffer4
        pool.returnBuffer(new byte[1000]);

        Assert.AreEqual(2, pool.pool.size());
    }

    [Test]
    public void ThrowsAwayOldBuffersWhenPoolExceedsSize_SameBytes()
    {
        BufferPool pool = new BufferPool(3);

        byte[] buffer1 = new byte[1024];
        byte[] buffer2 = new byte[1024];

        pool.returnBuffer(buffer1);
        pool.returnBuffer(buffer2);

        Assert.AreEqual(2, pool.pool.size());

        // This will remove the oldest (buffer1) and add buffer1
        pool.returnBuffer(buffer1);

        Assert.AreEqual(2, pool.pool.size());
    }

    [Test]
    public void ReturnsCorrectSize()
    {
        BufferPool pool = new BufferPool(100);
        byte[] buffer1 = new byte[20];
        byte[] buffer2 = new byte[50];

        pool.ReturnBuf(buffer1);
        pool.ReturnBuf(buffer2);

        Assert.AreEqual(70, pool.GetBuf(30).Length);
    }

    [Test]
    public void ReturnsCorrectSize_WithLargeBuffer()
    {
        BufferPool pool = new BufferPool(100);
        byte[] buffer = new byte[200];

        Assert.IsTrue(pool.ReturnBuf(buffer));
        Assert.AreEqual(0, pool.GetBuf(10).Length);
    }
}

                {
                    try
                    {
                        method.Invoke(null, new object[] { });
                        numPassed++;
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        // ignore exception
                    }

                    if (numPassed == testPool.GetType().GetMethods().Length) break;

                numPassed = 100 - numPassed;

                Console.WriteLine($"Passed: {numPassed}/{testPool.GetType().GetMethods().Length} - {((float)numPassed / testPool.GetType().GetMethods().Length * 100):F2}%");
            }
        }

namespace CodeSnippetExample
{
    using System;
    using System.Collections.Generic;
    using System.Linq;

    public abstract class AbstractOptionValue<TKey, TValue>
    {
        public abstract TKey Key { get; }
        public abstract TValue Value { get; }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            if (obj is AbstractOptionValue other)
                return Key == other.Key && Value == other.Value;
            return false;
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return (Key, Value).GetHashCode();
        }
    }

    public class ExampleOptionValue : AbstractOptionValue<string, int>
    {
        public string Key { get; } = "";
        public int Value { get; } = 0;

        public ExampleOptionValue(string key, int value)
        {
            Key = key;
            Value = value;
        }
    }

    public abstract class AbstractOptions
    {
        public virtual IDictionary<object, object> ValueMap { get; protected set; }
    }

    public class AbstractOptions<T> : AbstractOptions where T : AbstractOptionValue<,>
    {
        public new IDictionary<T, T> ValueMap { get; private set; }

        public AbstractOptions()
        {
            ValueMap = new Dictionary<T, T>();
            base.ValueMap = ValueMap.ToDictionary(x => (object)x.Key, x => (object)x.Value);
        }

        public AbstractOptions(IDictionary<T, T> map)
        {
            ValueMap = new Dictionary<T, T>(map);
            base.ValueMap = ValueMap.ToDictionary(x => (object)x.Key, x => (object)x.Value);
        }
    }

    public class OptionManager
    {
        protected AbstractOptions<T> CreateNewInstance<T>(Func<T, T> valueFilter, AbstractOptions baseOptions, IEnumerable<T> values)
            where T : AbstractOptionValue<,>
        {
            if (baseOptions == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(baseOptions));
            if (valueFilter == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(valueFilter));
            if (values == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(values));

            // Try to get existing value map or create new one
            var baseTypedOptions = baseOptions as AbstractOptions<T>;
            var valueMap = baseTypedOptions != null ? new Dictionary<T, T>(baseTypedOptions.ValueMap) : new Dictionary<T, T>();

            PutAll(valueMap, valueFilter, values.ToList());

            return new AbstractOptions<T>(valueMap);
        }

        protected void PutAll<T>(Dictionary<T, T> map, Func<T, T> valueFilter, List<T> values) where T : AbstractOptionValue<,>
        {
            foreach (var val in values)
            {
                var filtered = valueFilter(val);
                map[filtered] = filtered;
            }
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var option1 = new ExampleOptionValue("optionA", 1);
            var option2 = new ExampleOptionValue("optionB", 2);
            var option3 = new ExampleOptionValue("optionC", 3);

            var values = new List<ExampleOptionValue> { option1, option2, option3 };
            var baseOptions = new AbstractOptions<ExampleOptionValue>();

            OptionManager manager = new OptionManager();
            var newInstance = manager.CreateNewInstance<ExampleOptionValue>(
                v => new ExampleOptionValue(v.Key, v.Value * 10), // value filter multiplies value by 10
                baseOptions,
                values
            );

            Console.WriteLine("New Instance ValueMap:");
            foreach (var kvp in newInstance.ValueMap)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"{kvp.Key}: {kvp.Value}");
            }
        }
    }

}

    }

```java
import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;

public class CharSeqDemo {

    @Test
    public void testAppend() {
        CharSeq charSeq1 = new CharSeq("Hello");
        CharSeq charSeq2 = new CharSeq("World");
        charSeq1.append(charSeq2);
        assertEquals("HewllorW", charSeq1.toString());
    }

    @Test
    public void testEmptyCharSeqAppend() {
        CharSeq charSeq1 = new CharSeq("");
        CharSeq charSeq2 = new CharSeq("World");
        charSeq1.append(charSeq2);
        assertEquals("World", charSeq1.toString());
    }

    @Test
    public void testNullCharSeqAppend() {
        CharSeq charSeq1 = new CharSeq("Hello");
        CharSeq charSeq2 = null;
        charSeq1.append(charSeq2);
        assertEquals("Hello", charSeq1.toString());
    }

    @Test
    public void testDuplicateCharsInAppend() {
        CharSeq charSeq1 = new CharSeq("Hello");
        CharSeq charSeq2 = new CharSeq("Llo");
        charSeq1.append(charSeq2);
        assertEquals("Hellllo", charSeq1.toString());
    }

    @Test
    public void testSameLengthCharSeqAppend() {
        CharSeq charSeq1 = new CharSeq("Hello");
        CharSeq charSeq2 = new CharSeq("Hello");
        charSeq1.append(charSeq2);
        assertEquals("HelloHello", charSeq1.toString());
    }
}

class CharSeq {
    private char[] data;

    public CharSeq(String str) {
        this.data = str.toCharArray();
    }

    public void append(CharSeq other) {
        if (other == null || other.data == null) {
            return;
        }
        int newLength = this.data.length + other.data.length;
        char[] newData = new char[newLength];
        System.arraycopy(this.data, 0, newData, 0, this.data.length);
        System.arraycopy(other.data, 0, newData, this.data.length, other.data.length);
        this.data = newData;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new String(this.data);
    }
}
```
