import System;
using System;

namespace XPathNodeListExample
{
    // Stub for DTM class
    public static class DTM
    {
        public const int NULL = -1;
    }

    // Stub for error resources
    public static class XPATHErrorResources
    {
        public const string ER_NODESETDTM_NOT_MUTABLE = "NodeSetDTM is not mutable.";
    }

    // Stub for XSLMessages
    public static class XSLMessages
    {
        public static string CreateXPathMessage(string msg, object[] args)
        {
            return msg;
        }
    }

    // Simple XPathContext stub
    public class XPathContext
    {
        // Placeholder for context, add as needed
    }

    // Simulates XPath DTMIterator (node iterator)
    public abstract class DTMIterator
    {
        public abstract int NextNode();
    }

    // Example implementation of DTMIterator based on an array
    public class ArrayDTMIterator : DTMIterator
    {
        private readonly int[] _nodes;
        private int _index = 0;
        public ArrayDTMIterator(int[] nodes)
        {
            _nodes = nodes ?? Array.Empty<int>();
        }
        public override int NextNode()
        {
            if (_index < _nodes.Length)
            {
                return _nodes[_index++];
            }
            return DTM.NULL;
        }
    }

    // Main node list class
    public class NodeList
    {
        private System.Collections.Generic.List<int> nodes = new System.Collections.Generic.List<int>();
        private bool m_mutable;

        public NodeList(bool mutable = true)
        {
            m_mutable = mutable;
        }

        // Adds the node in document order (here, inserts into sorted order for simplicity)
        public void AddNodeInDocOrder(int node, XPathContext support)
        {
            if (node == DTM.NULL) return;
            // Insert in sorted order to simulate doc order
            int i = nodes.BinarySearch(node);
            if (i < 0)
            {
                nodes.Insert(~i, node);
            }
            // If i >= 0, node already exists; do nothing (skip duplicates)
        }

        // The ported code to add nodes from iterator, in doc order
        public void AddNodesInDocOrder(DTMIterator iterator, XPathContext support)
        {
            if (!m_mutable)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(XSLMessages.CreateXPathMessage(XPATHErrorResources.ER_NODESETDTM_NOT_MUTABLE, null));
            int node;
            while ((node = iterator.NextNode()) != DTM.NULL)
            {
                AddNodeInDocOrder(node, support);
            }
        }

        public void PrintNodes()
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Nodes in document order: " + string.Join(", ", nodes));
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main()
        {
            int[] nodeArray = { 10, 5, 8, 5, DTM.NULL, 20 };
            DTMIterator iterator = new ArrayDTMIterator(nodeArray);
            XPathContext context = new XPathContext();
            NodeList nodeList = new NodeList();

            // Add nodes in document order
            nodeList.AddNodesInDocOrder(iterator, context);

            nodeList.PrintNodes(); // Output: Nodes in document order: 5, 8, 10, 20

            // Uncomment the following to see the exception for immutable list:
            //NodeList immutableList = new NodeList(mutable: false);
            //immutableList.AddNodesInDocOrder(new ArrayDTMIterator(nodeArray), context);
        }
    }
}

```java
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;

public class DataFetcher {
    private static final Duration REFRESH_INTERVAL = Duration.ofMinutes(10);
    private Instant lastFetchedTime;
    private boolean dataValid;

    public DataFetcher() {
        this.lastFetchedTime = Instant.MIN;
        this.dataValid = false;
    }

    public boolean isDataValidAtCurrentTime() {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        if (Duration.between(lastFetchedTime, now).compareTo(REFRESH_INTERVAL) > 0) {
            fetchData();
        }
        return dataValid;
    }

    private void fetchData() {
        this.dataValid = true;
        this.lastFetchedTime = Instant.now();
        System.out.println("Data fetched at: " + lastFetchedTime);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
        DataFetcher fetcher = new DataFetcher();

        // Unit tests
        System.out.println("Test 1: First check, should fetch data");
        System.out.println(fetcher.isDataValidAtCurrentTime());

        System.out.println("Test 2: Second check within the refresh interval, should not fetch data");
        System.out.println(fetcher.isDataValidAtCurrentTime());

        System.out.println("Test 3: Wait for a period longer than refresh interval, should fetch data again");
        Thread.sleep(REFRESH_INTERVAL.plusSeconds(1).toMillis());
        System.out.println(fetcher.isDataValidAtCurrentTime());

        System.out.println("Test 4: Second check within the refresh interval, should not fetch data");
        System.out.println(fetcher.isDataValidAtCurrentTime());

        System.out.println("Test 5: Third check after refresh interval, should fetch data again");
        Thread.sleep(REFRESH_INTERVAL.plusSeconds(1).toMillis());
        System.out.println(fetcher.isDataValidAtCurrentTime());

        // Main function to run the program
    }
}
```

import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException;
import org.w3c.dom.DOMImplementation;
import org.w3c.dom.DocumentType;

public class CreateEmptyDocumentType {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            // Create a DocumentBuilderFactory
            DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
            // Create a DocumentBuilder
            DocumentBuilder builder = factory.newDocumentBuilder();
            // Get DOMImplementation from builder
            DOMImplementation domImpl = builder.getDOMImplementation();
            // Create a new empty DocumentType node
            // Empty name, publicId, and systemId
            DocumentType doctype = domImpl.createDocumentType("", "", "");
            // Print the DocumentType node's properties
            System.out.println("DocumentType node created:");
            System.out.println("Name: '" + doctype.getName() + "'");
            System.out.println("PublicId: '" + doctype.getPublicId() + "'");
            System.out.println("SystemId: '" + doctype.getSystemId() + "'");
        } catch (ParserConfigurationException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

using System;

namespace DomSample
{
    // Simulate DOM Level 2 DocumentType and related structures

    public class DocumentType
    {
        public string Name { get; }
        public string PublicId { get; }
        public string SystemId { get; }

        public DocumentType(string name, string publicId, string systemId)
        {
            Name = name;
            PublicId = publicId;
            SystemId = systemId;
        }

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return $"DocumentType(Name='{Name}', PublicId='{PublicId}', SystemId='{SystemId}')";
        }
    }

    public class DocumentTypeImpl : DocumentType
    {
        public object OwnerDocument { get; }

        public DocumentTypeImpl(object ownerDocument, string qualifiedName, string publicID, string systemID)
            : base(qualifiedName, publicID, systemID)
        {
            OwnerDocument = ownerDocument;
        }
    }

    public class DomImplementation
    {
        protected void CheckQName(string qualifiedName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(qualifiedName))
                throw new ArgumentException("Qualified name cannot be null or empty.");

            // Simple check: must be a valid XML name (very simplified)
            if (!char.IsLetter(qualifiedName[0]))
                throw new ArgumentException("Qualified name must start with a letter.");
            // For demonstration, not a comprehensive check
        }

        // introduced in dom level 2.
        // creates an empty documenttype node.
        public virtual DocumentType CreateDocumentType(string qualifiedName, string publicID, string systemID)
        {
            CheckQName(qualifiedName);
            return new DocumentTypeImpl(null, qualifiedName, publicID, systemID);
        }
    }

    public class CustomDomImplementation : DomImplementation
    {
        public override DocumentType CreateDocumentType(string qualifiedName, string publicID, string systemID)
        {
            CheckQName(qualifiedName);
            return new DocumentTypeImpl(null, qualifiedName, publicID, systemID);
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var domImpl = new CustomDomImplementation();
            try
            {
                // Example usage
                var docType = domImpl.CreateDocumentType("note", "//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Strict//EN", "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-strict.dtd");
                Console.WriteLine(docType);

                // Uncomment this to test invalid qualified name
                //var badDocType = domImpl.CreateDocumentType("1note", "public", "system");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Exception: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
    }

```java
import org.junit.Test;
import static org.junit.Assert.*;

public class CommandLineServiceTest {

    @Test
    public void testGreetCommand() {
        String[] args = {"greet", "Alice"};
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        service.service(args);
        assertEquals("Hello, Alice!", System.out.println());
    }

    @Test
    public void testSumCommand() {
        String[] args = {"sum", "1", "2", "3"};
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        service.service(args);
        assertEquals("Sum is: 6", System.out.println());
    }

    @Test
    public void testUnknownCommand() {
        String[] args = {};
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        service.service(args);
        assertEquals("No command provided.", System.out.println());
    }

    @Test
    public void testInvalidNumberInSumCommand() {
        String[] args = {"sum", "1", "a", "3"};
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        service.service(args);
        assertEquals("Invalid number: a", System.out.println());
    }
}

public class CommandLineService {
    public void service(String[] args) {
        // Services a commandline request.
        if (args == null || args.length == 0) {
            System.out.println("No command provided.");
            return;
        }
        String command = args[0];
        switch(command) {
            case "greet":
                System.out.println("Hello, " + (args.length > 1 ? args[1] : "World") + "!");
                break;
            case "sum":
                int sum = 0;
                for (int i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {
                    try {
                        sum += Integer.parseInt(args[i]);
                    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                        System.out.println("Invalid number: " + args[i]);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                System.out.println("Sum is: " + sum);
                break;
            default:
                System.out.println("Unknown command: " + command);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        service.service(args);
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace CommandLineService
{
    [TestClass]
    public class CommandLineServiceTest {

        [TestMethod]
        public void TestGreetCommand() {
            string[] args = { "greet", "Alice" };
            CommandLineServiceHandler handler = new CommandLineServiceHandler();
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            Console.WriteLine(System.Console.ReadLine());
            Assert.AreEqual("Hello, Alice!", Console.ReadLine());
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void TestSumCommand() {
            string[] args = { "sum", "1", "2", "3" };
            CommandLineServiceHandler handler = new CommandLineServiceHandler();
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            Console.WriteLine(Console.ReadLine());
            Assert.AreEqual("Found 3 matching agents:Agent Type:A", Console.ReadLine());
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void TestUnknownCommand() {
            string[] args = { };
            CommandLineServiceHandler handler = new CommandLineServiceHandler();
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            Console.WriteLine(Console.ReadLine());
            Assert.AreEqual("No command provided.", Console.ReadLine());
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void TestInvalidNumberInSumCommand() {
            string[] args = { "sum", "1", "a", "3" };
            CommandLineServiceHandler handler = new CommandLineServiceHandler();
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            Console.WriteLine(Console.ReadLine());
            Assert.AreEqual("Exception: Invalid number: a", Console.ReadLine());
        }
    }

    public class CommandLineServiceHandler : BaseHandler {
        private const string _STR = "*";

        private Dictionary<string, string> _options = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            { IArgument.REALM_NAME, "realm1" },
            { IArgument.AGENT_TYPE, null },
            { IArgument.FILTER, null }
        };

        public override void HandleRequest(RequestContext rc)
        {
            base.HandleRequest(rc);
            LdapLogin();
            SSOToken adminSSOToken = GetAdminSSOToken();
            IOutput outputWriter = GetOutputWriter();
            string realm = GetStringOptionValue(IArgument.REALM_NAME);
            string patternType = GetStringOptionValue(IArgument.AGENT_TYPE);
            string filter = GetStringOptionValue(IArgument.FILTER);

            if (patternType == null)
            {
                patternType = _STR;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))
            {
                filter = _STR;
            }
            string[] parameters = { realm, patternType, filter };
            WriteLog(LogWriter.LOG_ACCESS, LogLevel.INFO, _STR, parameters);

            try
            {
                AMIdentityRepository amir = new AMIdentityRepository(adminSSOToken, realm);
                IdSearchResults isr = amir.SearchIdentities(IdType.AGENTONLY, filter, new IdSearchControl());
                var results = isr.GetSearchResults();
                if (results != null && results.Count > 0)
                {
                    results.RemoveAll(am => !MatchType(am, patternType));
                }
                if (results != null)
                {
                    outputWriter.Write($"Found {results.Count} matching agents:");
                    foreach (var am in results)
                    {
                        outputWriter.Write($"Agent Type: {am.Type}");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    outputWriter.Write("No results found.");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                outputWriter.Write($"Exception: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        // Mocked methods
        private void LdapLogin()
        {
            Console.WriteLine("LdapLogin called.");
        }

        private SSOToken GetAdminSSOToken()
        {
            return new SSOToken();
        }

        private IOutput GetOutputWriter()
        {
            return new ConsoleOutput();
        }

        private string GetStringOptionValue(string key)
        {
            if (_options.TryGetValue(key, out string value))
            {
                return value
        }
```

```java
        String actualOutput = service.service(args);
        assertEquals("Hello, Alice!", actualOutput);
    }

    @Test
    public void testSumCommand() {
        String[] args = {"sum", "1", "2", "3"};
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        String actualOutput = service.service(args);
        assertEquals("Sum is: 6", actualOutput);
    }

    @Test
    public void testUnknownCommand() {
        String[] args = {};
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        String actualOutput = service.service(args);
        assertEquals("No command provided.", actualOutput);
    }

    @Test
    public void testInvalidNumberInSumCommand() {
        String[] args = {"sum", "1", "a", "3"};
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        String actualOutput = service.service(args);
        assertEquals("Invalid number: a", actualOutput);
    }
}

public class CommandLineService {
    public String service(String[] args) {
        // Services a commandline request.
        if (args == null || args.length == 0) {
            return "No command provided.";
        }
        String command = args[0];
        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
        switch(command) {
            case "greet":
                output.append("Hello, ").append((args.length > 1 ? args[1] : "World")).append("!");
                break;
            case "sum":
                int sum = 0;
                for (int i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {
                    try {
                        sum += Integer.parseInt(args[i]);
                    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                        output.append("Invalid number: ").append(args[i]).append("\n");
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(sum != 0) {
                    output.append("Sum is: ").append(sum);
                }
                break;
            default:
                output.append("Unknown command: ").append(command).append("\n");
        }
        return output.toString();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CommandLineService service = new CommandLineService();
        String actualOutput = service.service(args);
        System.out.println(actualOutput);
    }
}
```

```csharp
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            String actualOutput = Console.ReadLine();
            Assert.AreEqual("Hello, Alice!", actualOutput);
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void TestSumCommand() {
            string[] args = { "sum", "1", "2", "3" };
            CommandLineServiceHandler handler = new CommandLineServiceHandler();
            Output = Console.In;
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            String actualOutput = Console.ReadLine();
            Assert.AreEqual("Found 3 matching agents:Agent Type:A", actualOutput);
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void TestUnknownCommand() {
            string[] args = { };
            CommandLineServiceHandler handler = new CommandLineServiceHandler();
            Output = Console.In;
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            String actualOutput = Console.ReadLine();
            Assert.AreEqual("No command provided.", actualOutput);
        }

        [TestMethod]
        public void TestInvalidNumberInSumCommand() {
            string[] args = { "sum", "1", "a", "3" };
            CommandLineServiceHandler handler = new CommandLineServiceHandler();
            Output = Console.In;
            handler.HandleRequest(null); // pass null as RequestContext
            String actualOutput = Console.ReadLine();
            Assert.AreEqual("Exception: Invalid number: a", actualOutput);
        }

    public class CommandLineServiceHandler : BaseHandler {
        private const string _STR = "*";

        private Dictionary<string, string> _options = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            { IArgument.REALM_NAME, "realm1" },
            { IArgument.AGENT_TYPE, null },
            { IArgument.FILTER, null }
        };

        public override void HandleRequest(RequestContext rc)
        {
            base.HandleRequest(rc);
            LdapLogin();
            SSOToken adminSSOToken = GetAdminSSOToken();
            IOutput outputWriter = GetOutputWriter();
            String realm = GetStringOptionValue(IArgument.REALM_NAME);
            String patternType = GetStringOptionValue(IArgument.AGENT_TYPE);
            String filter = GetStringOptionValue(IArgument.FILTER);

            if (patternType == null)
            {
                patternType = _STR;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))
            {
                filter = _STR;
            }
            String[] parameters = { realm, patternType, filter };
            WriteLog(LogWriter.LOG_ACCESS, LogLevel.INFO, _STR, parameters);

            try
            {
                AMIdentityRepository amir = new AMIdentityRepository(adminSSOToken, realm);
                IdSearchResults isr = amir.SearchIdentities(IdType.AGENTONLY, filter, new IdSearchControl());
                String results = isr.GetSearchResults().ToString();
                if (results != null && results.Count > 0)
                {
                    results.RemoveAll(am => !MatchType(am, patternType));
                }
                if (results != null)
                {
                    outputWriter.Write($"Found {results.Count} matching agents:");
                    foreach (var am in results.Split(new[] { "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None))
                    {
                        outputWriter.Write(am);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    outputWriter.Write("No results found.");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                outputWriter.Write($"Exception: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        // Mocked methods
        private void LdapLogin()
        {
            Console.WriteLine("LdapLogin called.");
        }

        private SSOToken GetAdminSSOToken()
        {
            return new SSOToken();
        }

        private IOutput GetOutputWriter()
        {
            return new ConsoleOutput();
        }

        private String GetStringOptionValue(String key)
        {
            if (_options.TryGetValue(key, out String value))
            {
                return value;
            }
            return null;
        }

    {
        INFO
    }
```

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.ObjectOutputStream;

public class SerializeNestedObject {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            // Create an example nested object
            NestedObject obj = new NestedObject(new ExampleField("Example"), 42, new InnerObject("Inner", 99));
            // Serialize the object and get the byte array
            byte[] bytes = serializeToByteArray(obj);

            // Output the size of serialized byte array
            System.out.println("Serialized byte array length: " + bytes.length);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Serializes the specified object into a byte array.
     *
     * @param obj the object to serialize
     * @return a byte array containing the serialized object
     * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs during serialization
     */
    public static byte[] serializeToByteArray(NestedObject obj) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream byteStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        ObjectOutputStream objectStream = new ObjectOutputStream(byteStream);
        objectStream.writeObject(obj);
        objectStream.flush();
        // Returns the contents of the bytes stream as a byte array.
        return byteStream.toByteArray();
    }

    static class NestedObject implements Serializable {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
        IStorableField field;
        int value;
        InnerObject inner;

        NestedObject(IStorableField field, int value, InnerObject inner) {
            this.field = field;
            this.value = value;
            this.inner = inner;
        }
    }

    static class InnerObject implements Serializable {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
        String innerName;
        int innerValue;

        InnerObject(String innerName, int innerValue) {
            this.innerName = innerName;
            this.innerValue = innerValue;
        }
    }
}

C#: using System;
using System.IO;

public interface IStorableField
{
    void Store(Stream stream, object context);
}

public class NestedObject
{
    private IStorableField _field;

    public NestedObject(IStorableField field)
    {
        _field = field;
    }

    // serializes this nested object into byte [ ]
    public byte[] ToBytes()
    {
        try
        {
            using (var outStream = new MemoryStream())
            {
                _field.Store(outStream, null);
                return outStream.ToArray();
            }
        }
        catch (IOException e)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(e.Message, e);
        }
    }
}

// A simple implementation of IStorableField for demonstration
public class ExampleField : IStorableField
{
    private string _text;
    public ExampleField(string text)
    {
        _text = text;
    }

    public void Store(Stream stream, object context)
    {
        byte[] data = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_text);
        stream.Write(data, 0, data.Length);
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        IStorableField field = new ExampleField("Hello, World!");
        NestedObject nestedObject = new NestedObject(field);

        byte[] byteArray = nestedObject.ToBytes();

        Console.WriteLine("Serialized bytes:");
        Console.WriteLine(BitConverter.ToString(byteArray));
    }
}

public class StyleNameConverter {

    public enum Style {
        BOLD, ITALIC, UNDERLINE, STRIKETHROUGH
    }

    /**
     * Returns first enum constant found in a space-separated list of style names.
     */
    public static Style convertFromStyleName(String styleNames) {
        if (styleNames == null || styleNames.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        String[] names = styleNames.trim().split("\\s+");
        for (String name : names) {
            try {
                return Style.valueOf(name.toUpperCase());
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
                // Ignore and check next one
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example inputs
        String styleString1 = "italic underline";
        String styleString2 = "foo bold";
        String styleString3 = "notAStyle";
        String styleString4 = "";
        String styleString5 = null;

        System.out.println(convertFromStyleName(styleString1)); // ITALIC
        System.out.println(convertFromStyleName(styleString2)); // BOLD
        System.out.println(convertFromStyleName(styleString3)); // null
        System.out.println(convertFromStyleName(styleString4)); // null
        System.out.println(convertFromStyleName(styleString5)); // null
    }
}

public class StyleParser {

    public static <E extends Enum<E> & HasCssName>
    E FromStyleName(String styleName, Class<E> enumClass, E defaultValue) {
        if (styleName == null || enumClass == null)
        {
            return defaultValue;
        }

        foreach(E constant in Enum.GetValues(enumClass).Cast<E>())
        {
            var anEnum = constant as HasCssName;
            string cssClass = anEnum?.GetCssName();
            if (cssClass != null && StyleHelper.ContainsStyle(styleName, cssClass))
            {
                return constant;
            }
        }
        return defaultValue;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example inputs
        String styleString1 = "italic underline";
        String styleString2 = "foo bold";
        String styleString3 = "notAStyle";
        String styleString4 = "";
        String styleString5 = null;

        System.out.println(FromStyleName(styleString1, Style.class, (E) null)); // ITALIC
        System.out.println(FromStyleName(styleString2, Style.class, (E) null)); // BOLD
        System.out.println(FromStyleName(styleString3, Style.class, (E) null)); // null
        System.out.println(FromStyleName(styleString4, Style.class, (E) null)); // null
        System.out.println(FromStyleName(styleString5, Style.class, (E) null)); // null
    }
}

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

class StyleHelper {
    public static boolean ContainsStyle(String styleNames, String styleName)
    {
        if (styleNames == null || styleName == null)
            return false;

        var styles = styleNames.split(new[] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return Arrays.asList(styles).contains(styleName.toUpperCase());
    }
}

public class StyleParser {

    public static E FromStyleName(String styleName, Type enumType, E defaultValue) {
        if (styleName == null || enumType == null)
        {
            return defaultValue;

        foreach(Enum em in Enum.GetValues(enumType))
        {
            var anEnum = em as IHasCssName;
            string cssClass = anEnum?.GetCssName();
            if (cssClass != null && StyleHelper.ContainsStyle(styleName, cssClass))

        private Logger log = new Logger();
        private int videoFrameCount = 0;
        private bool startedMpeg = false;

        private int HleMpegGetAvcAu(object obj)
        {
            // Just return a sample result for demonstration purposes
            // Simulate this returns a valid frame index or -1
            Random rnd = new Random();
            return rnd.Next(0, 2) == 0 ? -1 : rnd.Next(100, 200);
        }

        public int SceMpegNextAvcRpAu(int mpeg, int streamUid)
        {
            if (!streamMap.ContainsKey(streamUid))
            {
                log.Warn(string.Format("{0}", streamUid));
                return -1; // Replace _NUM with -1
            }
            int result = HleMpegGetAvcAu(null);
            if (result != -1) // Replace _NUM with -1
            {
                if (log.IsDebugEnabled)
                {
                    log.Debug(string.Format("{0}", result));
                }
                return result;
            }
            videoFrameCount++;
            startedMpeg = true; // Replace _BOOL with true
            return -1; // Replace _NUM with -1
        }

        public void AddStream(int streamUid)
        {
            if (!streamMap.ContainsKey(streamUid))
            {
                streamMap[streamUid] = new object();
            }
        }
    }

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

class ExportMask {
    private String id;
    private String name;

    public ExportMask(String id, String name) {
        this.id = id;
        this.name = name;
    }

    public String getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "ExportMask{id='" + id + "', name='" + name + "'}";
    }
}

public class ExportMaskMapper {

    // Mock database of export masks
    private static final Map<String, ExportMask> EXPORT_MASK_DB = new HashMap<>();

    static {
        // Initialize some mock data
        EXPORT_MASK_DB.put("uri-1", new ExportMask("uri-1", "ExportMaskOne"));
        EXPORT_MASK_DB.put("uri-2", new ExportMask("uri-2", "ExportMaskTwo"));
        EXPORT_MASK_DB.put("uri-3", new ExportMask("uri-3", "ExportMaskThree"));
    }

    /**
     * Given a set of exportMaskUris, return a map of exportMaskUri to ExportMask object.
     */
    public static Map<String, ExportMask> getExportMasksForUris(Set<String> exportMaskUris) {
        Map<String, ExportMask> result = new HashMap<>();
        for (String uri : exportMaskUris) {
            ExportMask mask = EXPORT_MASK_DB.get(uri);
            if (mask != null) {
                result.put(uri, mask);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Set<String> uris = Set.of("uri-1", "uri-3", "uri-nonexistent");
        Map<String, ExportMask> maskMap = getExportMasksForUris(uris);
        System.out.println("ExportMask map:");
        for (Map.Entry<String, ExportMask> entry : maskMap.entrySet()) {
            System.out.println(entry.getKey() + " -> " + entry.getValue());
        }
    }
}

public class ExportMaskMapperTest {

    @org.junit.Test
    public void testGetExportMasksForUrisNoMatch() {
        Set<String> exportMaskUris = Set.of("uri-1", "uri-4");
        Map<String, ExportMask> result = ExportMaskMapper.getExportMasksForUris(exportMaskUris);
        org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(result.size(), 0);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void testGetExportMasksForUrisSingleMatch() {
        Set<String> exportMaskUris = Set.of("uri-1");
        Map<String, ExportMask> result = ExportMaskMapper.getExportMasksForUris(exportMaskUris);
        org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(result.size(), 1);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void testGetExportMasksForUrisMultipleMatches() {
        Set<String> exportMaskUris = Set.of("uri-1", "uri-2");
        Map<String, ExportMask> result = ExportMaskMapper.getExportMasksForUris(exportMaskUris);
        org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(result.size(), 2);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void testGetExportMasksForUrisNoMatchingUri() {
        Set<String> exportMaskUris = Set.of("uri-1", "uri-3");
        Map<String, ExportMask> result = ExportMaskMapper.getExportMasksForUris(exportMaskUris);
        org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(result.size(), 2);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void testGetExportMasksForUrisEmptyUriSet() {
        Set<String> exportMaskUris = Set.of();
        Map<String, ExportMask> result = ExportMaskMapper.getExportMasksForUris(exportMaskUris);
        org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(result.size(), 0);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace ExportMaskExample
{
    // Stub definition for ExportMask
    public class ExportMask
    {
        private Uri _id;

        public ExportMask(Uri id)
        {
            _id = id;
        }

        public Uri GetId()
        {
            return _id;
        }
    }

    // Stub definition for DbClient with an iterator method
    public class DbClient
    {
        private Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> _maskStorage;

        public DbClient(Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> maskStorage)
        {
            _maskStorage = maskStorage;
        }

        public IEnumerator<ExportMask> QueryIterativeObjects<T>(HashSet<Uri> uris, bool whatever)
        {
            foreach (var uri in uris)
            {
                if (_maskStorage.TryGetValue(uri, out ExportMask mask))
                    yield return mask;
            }
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        private DbClient dbClient;

        public Program(DbClient dbClient)
        {
            this.dbClient = dbClient;
        }

        // given a set of exportmask uris, return a map of exportmask uri to exportmask object
        private Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> CreateExportMaskMap(HashSet<Uri> placedMasks)
        {
            Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> exportMaskMap = new Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask>();
            var exportMaskIterator = dbClient.QueryIterativeObjects<ExportMask>(placedMasks, true);
            while (exportMaskIterator.MoveNext())
            {
                ExportMask exportMask = exportMaskIterator.Current;
                exportMaskMap[exportMask.GetId()] = exportMask;
            }
            return exportMaskMap;
        }

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            // Create some ExportMasks
            Uri uri1 = new Uri("http://example.com/mask/1");
            Uri uri2 = new Uri("http://example.com/mask/2");
            ExportMask mask1 = new ExportMask(uri1);
            ExportMask mask2 = new ExportMask(uri2);

            // Individually populate dummy database
            var maskStorage = new Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask>
            {
                { uri1, mask1 },
                { uri2, mask2 }
            };

            DbClient dbClient = new DbClient(maskStorage);
            Program program = new Program(dbClient);

            // Create set of uris to look up
            var urisToFind = new HashSet<Uri> { uri1, uri2 };

            var result = program.CreateExportMaskMap(urisToFind);

            // Print results
            foreach (var kvp in result)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"URI: {kvp.Key} -> ExportMask ID: {kvp.Value.GetId()}");
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;

public class DataUtils
{
    // Copies from source to destination, leaving a gap at the specified index.
    // For simplicity, we copy [0,index) then [index,length) to [index+1,length+1)
    public static void CopyWithGap<K>(K[] source, K[] dest, int length, int gapIndex)
    {
        Array.Copy(source, 0, dest, 0, gapIndex);
        Array.Copy(source, gapIndex, dest, gapIndex + 1, length - gapIndex);
    }
}

public class ImmutableArray2<K>
{
    internal readonly K[] array;
    internal readonly int length;
    internal readonly bool extendable;

    // Simulate extendibility with an AtomicBoolean replacement
    internal AtomicBool? canExtend;

    public const int _NUM = 1;
    public const bool _BOOL = true;

    public ImmutableArray2(K[] array, int length, bool extendable)
    {
        this.array = array;
        this.length = length;
        this.extendable = extendable;
        this.canExtend = extendable ? new AtomicBool(false) : null;
    }

    // insert an entry at this index.
    public ImmutableArray2<K> Insert(int index, K obj)
    {
        int len = length + _NUM;
        int newLen = len;
        bool extendable;

        if (index == len - _NUM)
        {
            var x = canExtend;
            if (x != null)
            {
                canExtend = null;
                if (array.Length > index && x.GetAndSet(_BOOL))
                {
                    array[index] = obj;
                    return new ImmutableArray2<K>(array, len, _BOOL);
                }
            }
            extendable = _BOOL;
            newLen = len + _NUM;
        }
        else
        {
            extendable = _BOOL;
        }
        K[] a2 = new K[newLen];
        DataUtils.CopyWithGap(array, a2, length, index);
        a2[index] = obj;
        return new ImmutableArray2<K>(a2, len, extendable);
    }

    public override string ToString()
    {
        return $"[{string.Join(", ", array.AsSpan(0, length))}]";
    }
}

public class AtomicBool
{
    private int value;

    public AtomicBool(bool initialValue)
    {
        value = initialValue ? 1 : 0;
    }

    // Returns old value, sets new value
    public bool GetAndSet(bool newValue)
    {
        int newInt = newValue ? 1 : 0;
        int old = Interlocked.Exchange(ref value, newInt);
        return old != 0;
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        var immutable = new ImmutableArray2<int>((int[])new int[] { 1, 2, 3 }, 3, true);
        Console.WriteLine("Original: " + immutable);

        var inserted = immutable.Insert(1, 99);
        Console.WriteLine("After Insert at index 1: " + inserted);

        var inserted2 = inserted.Insert(4, 88); // new entry at the end (simulate extended length)
        Console.WriteLine("After Insert at index 4: " + inserted2);
    }
}

public class ImagePrintDemo implements Printable {

    private Image image;

    public ImagePrintDemo(Image image) {
        this.image = image;
    }

    // This was not in the original class, but was added afterwards by Kevin Dickerson.
    // It is a copy of the write, but without the scaling.
    // The image is positioned on the right side of the paper, at the current height.
    @Override
    public int print(Graphics g, PageFormat pf, int pageIndex) throws PrinterException {
        if (pageIndex > 0) {
            return NO_SUCH_PAGE;
        }

        int imgWidth = image.getWidth(null);
        int imgHeight = image.getHeight(null);

        // Position the image on the right side of the paper, at the current height.
        double paperWidth = pf.getImageableWidth();
        double paperHeight = pf.getImageableHeight();
        double paperX = pf.getImageableX();
        double paperY = pf.getImageableY();

        int x = (int) (paperX + paperWidth - imgWidth);
        int y = (int) paperY; // position at the current height (top)

        g.drawImage(image, x, y, null);

        return PAGE_EXISTS;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Load an example image for demonstration purposes.
        // Make sure you have an appropriate image file or replace with your own.
        Image image = new ImageIcon("example.jpg").getImage(); // Replace with your image path

        PrinterJob job = PrinterJob.getPrinterJob();
        job.setPrintable(new ImagePrintDemo(image));

        boolean doPrint = job.printDialog();
        if (doPrint) {
            try {
                job.print();
            } catch (PrinterException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }
    }
}

public class Printout
{
    private int x0 = 10;
    private int y0 = 10;
    private int width = 500;
    private int charwidth = 7;
    private int linenum = 0;
    private int lineheight = 20;
    private int lineascent = 15;
    private int pagenum = 1;
    private int prFirst = 1;

    private Graphics page;

    public void NewPage()
    {
        // For demonstration, create a bitmap and get its Graphics context
        Bitmap bmp = new Bitmap(600, 800);
        page = Graphics.FromImage(bmp);
        page.Clear(Color.White);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Write a graphic to the printout.
    /// This was not in the original class, but was added afterwards by Kevin Dickerson.
    /// It is a copy of the write, but without the scaling.
    /// The image is positioned on the right side of the paper, at the current height.
    /// </summary>
    public void WriteNoScale(Image c, Component i)
    {
        if (page == null)
        {
            NewPage();
        }
        int x = x0 + width - (c.Width + charwidth);
        int y = y0 + (linenum * lineheight) + lineascent;
        if (page != null && pagenum >= prFirst)
        {
            page.DrawImage(c, x, y, c.Width, c.Height);
        }
        // For demonstration, save the result
        if (page != null)
        {
            Bitmap bmp = new Bitmap(600, 800);
            Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(bmp);
            g.Clear(Color.White);
            g.DrawImage((Bitmap)page, 0, 0);
            bmp.Save("output.png");
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        Printout printout = new Printout();
        // Create a sample image
        Bitmap img = new Bitmap(100, 50);
        using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(img))
        {
            g.Clear(Color.Red);
            g.DrawRectangle(Pens.Black, 10, 10, 80, 30);
        }
        Component comp = new Component();
        printout.WriteNoScale(img, comp);
        Console.WriteLine("Image written to output.png");
    }
}

```java
public class ProgressUpdate {

    private String message;
    private int progress; // 0 to 100

    // Constructor
    public ProgressUpdate(String message, int progress) {
        this.message = message;
        this.progress = progress;
    }

    // Getter for message
    public String getMessage() {
        return message;
    }

    // Getter for progress
    public int getProgress() {
        return progress;
    }

    // Setter for message
    public void setMessage(String message) {
        this.message = message;
    }

    // Setter for progress
    public void setProgress(int progress) {
        this.progress = progress;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "ProgressUpdate{" +
                "message='" + message + '\'' +
                ", progress=" + progress +
                '}';
    }

    // For demo purposes: simulate communication of progress updates
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Simulate a plugin tool sending progress updates
        ProgressUpdate update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Initializing...", 0);
        ProgressUpdate update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Processing data...", 50);
        ProgressUpdate update3 = new ProgressUpdate("Finalizing...", 100);

        // Simulate main whitebox user interface receiving updates
        displayProgress(update1);
        displayProgress(update2);
        displayProgress(update3);
    }

    // Simulated UI display
    public static void displayProgress(ProgressUpdate update) {
        System.out.println("Received progress update: " + update.getMessage() + " (" + update.getProgress() + "%)");
    }
}

public class ProgressUpdateTest {

    @org.junit.Test
    public void test_progress_update_initiation() {
        ProgressUpdate update = new ProgressUpdate("Initialization", 0);
        assert(update.getMessage().equals("Initialization"));
        assert(update.getProgress() == 0);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void test_progress_update_message_change() {
        ProgressUpdate update = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);
        update.setMessage("Processing data...");
        assert(!update.getMessage().equals("Loading Data"));
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void test_progress_update_progress_increase() {
        ProgressUpdate update = new ProgressUpdate("Initialization", 0);
        update.setProgress(50);
        assert(update.getProgress() == 50);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void test_progress_update_multiple_updates() {
        ProgressUpdate update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Initialization", 0);
        ProgressUpdate update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Processing data...", 50);
        ProgressUpdate update3 = new ProgressUpdate("Finalizing...", 100);

        displayProgress(update1);
        displayProgress(update2);
        displayProgress(update3);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void test_progress_update_same_label_no_change() {
        ProgressUpdate update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);
        ProgressUpdate update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Processing data...", 50);

        assert(!update1.getMessage().equals(update2.getMessage()));
        assert(update1.getProgress() != update2.getProgress());
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void test_progress_update_same_label_change() {
        ProgressUpdate update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);
        ProgressUpdate update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Processing data...", 50);

        update1.setProgress(70);
        assert(update1.getProgress() == 70);
    }

    @org.junit.Test
    public void test_progress_update_same_label_no_change_same_label_same_progress() {
        ProgressUpdate update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);
        ProgressUpdate update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Processing data...", 50);

        update1.setProgress(50);
        assert(update1.getProgress() == 50);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace PluginProgressUpdateTests
{
    public class ProgressHandlerTest
    {
        private IHost _host;
        private int _previousProgress = -1;

        [Fact]
        public void TestInitiation()
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            _host = host;
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);
            var update = new ProgressUpdate("Initialization", 0);

            Assert.Equal("Initialization", handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10).Label);
            Assert.Equal(0, handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10).Progress);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestMessageChange()
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            _host = host;
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);
            var update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Initialization", 0);
            var update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);

            handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress);
            Assert.NotEqual(update1.Message, update2.Message);

            handler.UpdateProgress(update2.Message, update2.Progress);
            Assert.Equal(update1.Message, handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress).Label);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestProgressIncrease()
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            _host = host;
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);
            var update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Initialization", 0);

            handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress);
            handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10);
            Assert.Equal(10, handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10).Progress);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestMultipleUpdates()
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            _host = host;
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);

            var update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Initialization", 0);
            var update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);
            var update3 = new ProgressUpdate("Processing data...", 50);

            handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress);
            handler.UpdateProgress(update2.Message, update2.Progress);
            handler.UpdateProgress(update3.Message, update3.Progress);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestSameLabelNoChange()
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            _host = host;
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);

            var update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);
            var update2 = new ProgressUpdate("Processing data...", 50);

            handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress);
            Assert.NotEqual(handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress).Label, update2.Label);
            Assert.NotEqual(handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress).Progress, update2.Progress);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestSameLabelChange()
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            _host = host;
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);

            var update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);

            handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress);
            Assert.Equal(10, handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10).Progress);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestSameLabelNoChangeSameLabelSameProgress()
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            _host = host;
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);

            var update1 = new ProgressUpdate("Loading Data", 10);

            handler.UpdateProgress(update1.Message, update1.Progress);
            Assert.Equal(10, handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10).Progress);
        }
    }

    public class MainHost : IHost
    {
        public void UpdateProgress(string progressLabel, int progress)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{progressLabel}: {progress}%");
        }
    }

    public interface IHost
    {
        void UpdateProgress(string progressLabel, int progress);
    }

    public class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var host = new MainHost();
            var handler = new ProgressHandler(host);

            handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10);
            handler.UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 50);
            handler.UpdateProgress("Processing", 70);
            handler.UpdateProgress("Complete", 100);
        }
    }
}
```

import java.io.*;
public class ResourceCopyExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example input and output file paths
        String inputFilePath = "input.txt";
        String outputFilePath = "output.txt";

        // Copy input resource to output resource
        try (
            InputStream in = new FileInputStream(inputFilePath);
            OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(outputFilePath)
        ) {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
            int bytesRead;
            while ((bytesRead = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                out.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
            }
            System.out.println("Resource copied successfully.");
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;

public class Resource
{
    private readonly string _path;

    public Resource(string path)
    {
        _path = path;
    }

    public Stream GetOutputStream()
    {
        return new FileStream(_path, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
    }
}

public static class IOUtil
{
    public static void CloseEL(Stream stream)
    {
        if (stream != null)
        {
            try
            {
                stream.Close();
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignore
            }
        }
    }
}

public class Copier
{
    private const bool _BOOL = true;

    public static void Copy(Stream inputStream, Resource outputResource, bool closeInputStream)
    {
        Stream outputStream = null;
        try
        {
            outputStream = ToBufferedOutputStream(outputResource.GetOutputStream());
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
            IOUtil.CloseEL(outputStream);
            throw;
        }
        Copy(inputStream, outputStream, closeInputStream, _BOOL);
    }

    public static Stream ToBufferedOutputStream(Stream outputStream)
    {
        return new BufferedStream(outputStream, 8192);
    }

    public static void Copy(Stream inputStream, Stream outputStream, bool closeInputStream, bool closeOutputStream)
    {
        try
        {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
            int read;
            while ((read = inputStream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length)) > 0)
            {
                outputStream.Write(buffer, 0, read);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            if (closeInputStream && inputStream != null)
            {
                inputStream.Close();
            }
            if (closeOutputStream && outputStream != null)
            {
                outputStream.Close();
            }
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        // Example: Copy file "input.txt" to "output.txt"
        string inputPath = "input.txt";
        string outputPath = "output.txt";
        using (FileStream inputStream = new FileStream(inputPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
        {
            Resource outputResource = new Resource(outputPath);
            Copier.Copy(inputStream, outputResource, true);
        }
        Console.WriteLine("Copy completed.");
    }
}

import java.io.IOException;

public class FadeAudioWithSox {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example usage:
        String inputPath = "input.wav";
        String outputPath = "output.wav";
        String type = "t";            // type 't' for linear fade (or 'q' for quadratic)
        String fadeInLength = "3";    // 3 seconds fade in
        String stopTime = "10";       // total audio duration (10 seconds)
        String fadeOutLength = "3";   // 3 seconds fade out

        String[] command = {
            "sox",
            inputPath,
            outputPath,
            "fade",
            type,
            fadeInLength,
            stopTime,
            fadeOutLength
        };

        try {
            Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command)
                .inheritIO()
                .start();

            int exitCode = process.waitFor();
            if (exitCode == 0) {
                System.out.println("Audio faded successfully.");
            } else {
                System.out.println("Error: Sox process exited with code " + exitCode);
            }
        } catch (IOException | InterruptedException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

namespace AudioFadeApp
{
    class Program
    {
        // Stand-ins for obfuscated constants
        private const string _STR = "FADE";
        private const int _NUM = -1;
        private static string soxBin = "sox";

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            // Example Usage
            string inputPath = "input.wav";
            string type = "FADE"; // Must be in curves
            double fadeInLength = 1.5;
            double stopTime = 5.0;
            double fadeOutLength = 2.0;

            Program p = new Program();
            string result = p.FadeAudio(inputPath, type, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);

            Console.WriteLine("Output file: " + result);
        }

        public static void testFadeAudio() {
            string inputPath = "input.wav";
            string outputPath = "output1.wav";
            string type = "t";            // type 't' for linear fade (or 'q' for quadratic)
            double fadeInLength = 3;    // 3 seconds fade in
            double stopTime = 10;       // total audio duration (10 seconds)
            double fadeOutLength = 3;   // 3 seconds fade out

            Program p = new Program();
            string result = p.FadeAudio(inputPath, type, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);

            Console.WriteLine("Output file: " + result);

            inputPath = "input2.wav";
            outputPath = "output2.wav";
            type = "q";            // type 't' for linear fade (or 'q' for quadratic)
            fadeInLength = 3;    // 3 seconds fade in
            stopTime = 10;       // total audio duration (10 seconds)
            fadeOutLength = 3;   // 3 seconds fade out

            result = p.FadeAudio(inputPath, type, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);

            Console.WriteLine("Output file: " + result);

            inputPath = "input3.wav";
            outputPath = "output3.wav";
            type = "q";            // type 't' for linear fade (or 'q' for quadratic)
            fadeInLength = 1;    // 1 second fade in
            stopTime = 5.0;      // total audio duration (5 seconds)
            fadeOutLength = 2.0; // 2 seconds fade out

            result = p.FadeAudio(inputPath, type, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);

            Console.WriteLine("Output file: " + result);

            inputPath = "input4.wav";
            outputPath = "output4.wav";
            type = "t";            // type 't' for linear fade (or 'q' for quadratic)
            fadeInLength = 10;   // 10 seconds fade in
            stopTime = 10;       // total audio duration (10 seconds)
            fadeOutLength = 10;  // 10 seconds fade out

            result = p.FadeAudio(inputPath, type, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);

            Console.WriteLine("Output file: " + result);

            inputPath = "input5.wav";
            outputPath = "output5.wav";
            type = "t";            // type 't' for linear fade (or 'q' for quadratic)
            fadeInLength = 1;    // 1 second fade in
            stopTime = 1.0;     // total audio duration (1 seconds)
            fadeOutLength = 2.0; // 2 seconds fade out

            result = p.FadeAudio(inputPath, type, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);

            Console.WriteLine("Output file: " + result);
        }

        public static string FadeAudio(string path, string type, double fadeInLength, double stopTime, double fadeOutLength)
        {
            var curves = new List<string> { _STR, _STR, _STR, _STR, _STR };
            if (!curves.Contains(type))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(_STR + type);
            }
            var file = new FileInfo(path);
            string outFile = file.FullName + _STR;
            var cmd = new List<string> { soxBin, path, outFile, _STR, type, fadeInLength + _STR };
            if (stopTime != _NUM)
                cmd.Add(stopTime + _STR);
            if (fadeOutLength != _NUM)
                cmd.Add(fadeOutLength + _STR);
            try
            {
                int rc = ExecSox(cmd, Callback);
                if (rc != _NUM)
                {
                    outFile = null;
                }
            }
            catch (IOException e)
            {
                PrintStackTrace(e);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                PrintStackTrace(e);
            }
            return outFile;
        }

        // Dummy implementation of callback and ExecSox
        private static void Callback(string data)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Callback: " + data);
        }

        private static int ExecSox(List<string> cmd, Action<string> callback)
        {
            // For demonstration, just print command and call callback
            Console.WriteLine("Executing: " + string.Join(" ", cmd));
            callback("Processing done.");
            return 0; // success
        }

        private static void PrintStackTrace(Exception e)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Exception caught: " + e.ToString());
        }
    }
}
public class ProgramTest {

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        testFadeAudio();
    }
}

import javax.swing.*;
import java.awt.*;

public class CanvasOutlineDemo extends JPanel {

    @Override
    protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
        super.paintComponent(g);
        // Draw the outline of the canvas (the panel itself)
        g.setColor(Color.BLACK);
        g.drawRect(0, 0, getWidth()-1, getHeight()-1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        JFrame frame = new JFrame("Canvas Outline Demo");
        CanvasOutlineDemo panel = new CanvasOutlineDemo();
        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
        frame.setSize(400, 300);
        frame.add(panel);
        frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
        frame.setVisible(true);
    }
}

    public class EdgeGlow
    {
        private bool finished;
        public EdgeGlow(bool isFinished = false)
        {

        }

        public bool IsFinished()
        {
            return !finished;
        }

        public void SetSize(int width, int height)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"EdgeGlow.SetSize({width}, {height})");
        }

        public bool Draw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("EdgeGlow.Draw()");
            finished = true;
            return true;
        }

    }

    public class BaseDrawable
    {
        public virtual void Draw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("BaseDrawable.Draw()");
        }

        public virtual void Invalidate()
        {
            Console.WriteLine("BaseDrawable.Invalidate()");
        }
    }

    public class GlowListView : BaseDrawable
    {
        protected EdgeGlow mEdgeGlowTop;
        protected EdgeGlow mEdgeGlowBottom;
        protected Padding mListPadding;
        protected int mGlowPaddingTop;
        protected int mGlowPaddingBottom;
        protected int mFirstPositionDistanceGuess;

        protected const int _NUM = 10;

        public GlowListView()
        {
            mEdgeGlowTop = new EdgeGlow();
            mEdgeGlowBottom = new EdgeGlow();
            mListPadding = new Padding { Top = 1, Bottom = 2, Left = 3, Right = 4 };
            mGlowPaddingTop = 2;
            mGlowPaddingBottom = 2;
            mFirstPositionDistanceGuess = 5;
        }

        public int GetScrollX()
        {
            return 20;
        }

        public int GetHeight()
        {
            return 100;
        }

        public int GetWidth()
        {
            return 60;
        }

        public override void Draw(Canvas canvas)
        {
            base.Draw(canvas);
            if (mEdgeGlowTop != null)
            {
                int scrollX = GetScrollX();
                if (!mEdgeGlowTop.IsFinished())
                {
                    int restoreCount = canvas.Save();
                    int topPadding = mListPadding.Top + mGlowPaddingTop;
                    int bottomPadding = mListPadding.Bottom + mGlowPaddingBottom;
                    int height = GetHeight() - topPadding - bottomPadding;
                    int edgeX = Math.Min(_NUM, scrollX + mFirstPositionDistanceGuess);
                    canvas.Rotate(-_NUM);
                    canvas.Translate(-GetHeight() + topPadding, edgeX);
                    mEdgeGlowTop.SetSize(height, height);
                    if (mEdgeGlowTop.Draw(canvas))
                    {
                        Invalidate();
                    }
                    canvas.RestoreToCount(restoreCount);
                }

                if (!mEdgeGlowBottom.IsFinished())
                {
                    int restoreCount = canvas.Save();
                    int topPadding = mListPadding.Left + mGlowPaddingTop;
                    int bottomPadding = mListPadding.Right + mGlowPaddingBottom;
                    int height = GetHeight() - topPadding - bottomPadding;
                    int width = GetWidth();
                    Console.WriteLine($"Bottom Glow: Height={height}, Width={width}");
                    canvas.RestoreToCount(restoreCount);
                }
            }
        }

        public override void Invalidate()
        {
            Console.WriteLine("GlowListView.Invalidate()");
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Canvas canvas = new Canvas();
            GlowListView glowListView = new GlowListView();
            glowListView.Draw(canvas);
        }
    }
}

import java.lang.annotation.*;
import java.lang.reflect.*;
import java.util.*;

@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target({ElementType.FIELD, ElementType.TYPE})
@interface PlatformProperty {
    String value();
    String platform();
}

@PlatformProperty(value = "MainClassProperty", platform = "Linux")
class MainClass {
    @PlatformProperty(value = "id", platform = "Linux")
    private int id;

    @PlatformProperty(value = "name", platform = "Linux")
    private String name;
}

@PlatformProperty(value = "SecondaryClassProperty", platform = "Windows")
class SecondaryClass {
    @PlatformProperty(value = "description", platform = "Windows")
    private String description;

    @PlatformProperty(value = "code", platform = "Windows")
    private int code;
}

public class Loader {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<Class<?>> classes = Arrays.asList(MainClass.class, SecondaryClass.class);
        String platform = "Linux";
        Map<String, List<String>> classProperties = new HashMap<>();

        for (Class<?> clazz : classes) {
            List<String> properties = new ArrayList<>();
            if (clazz.isAnnotationPresent(PlatformProperty.class)) {
                PlatformProperty classAnn = clazz.getAnnotation(PlatformProperty.class);
                if (platform.equals(classAnn.platform())) {
                    properties.add("ClassAnnotation: " + classAnn.value());
                }
            }
            for (Field field : clazz.getDeclaredFields()) {
                if (field.isAnnotationPresent(PlatformProperty.class)) {
                    PlatformProperty fieldAnn = field.getAnnotation(PlatformProperty.class);
                    if (platform.equals(fieldAnn.platform())) {
                        properties.add("Field: " + field.getName() + ", Value: " + fieldAnn.value());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!properties.isEmpty()) {
                classProperties.put(clazz.getSimpleName(), properties);
            }
        }

        for (Map.Entry<String, List<String>> entry : classProperties.entrySet()) {
            System.out.println("Class: " + entry.getKey());
            for (String prop : entry.getValue()) {
                System.out.println("  " + prop);
            }
        }
    }
}

import System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Properties
{
    private Dictionary<string, object> _props = new Dictionary<string, object>();
    public void Set(string key, object value)
    {
        _props[key] = value;
    }
    public object Get(string key)
    {
        return _props.ContainsKey(key) ? _props[key] : null;
    }
}

public class ClassProperties
{
    private Properties _properties;
    public ClassProperties(Properties properties)
    {
        _properties = properties;
    }
    public void Load(Type type, bool inherit)
    {
        foreach (var prop in type.GetProperties())
        {
            var attrs = prop.GetCustomAttributes(inherit);
            foreach (var attr in attrs)
            {
                _properties.Set($"{type.Name}.{prop.Name}.{attr.GetType().Name}", attr);
            }
        }
    }
    public Properties GetProperties()
    {
        return _properties;
    }
}

[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property)]
public class MyAnnotationAttribute : Attribute
{
    public string Info { get; }
    public MyAnnotationAttribute(string info)
    {
        Info = info;
    }
}

public class Example1
{
    [MyAnnotation("SomeInfo1")]
    public int PropertyA { get; set; }
}

public class Example2
{
    [MyAnnotation("SomeInfo2")]
    public string PropertyB { get; set; }
}

public class Program
{
    public static ClassProperties LoadProperties(Type[] cls, Properties properties, bool inherit)
    {
        ClassProperties cp = new ClassProperties(properties);
        foreach (Type c in cls)
        {
            cp.Load(c, inherit);
        }
        return cp;
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        Type[] types = { typeof(Example1), typeof(Example2) };
        Properties props = new Properties();
        ClassProperties classProps = LoadProperties(types, props, true);

        // Print out all properties loaded
        foreach (var field in typeof(Properties).GetField("_props", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(props) as Dictionary<string, object>)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{field.Key}: {field.Value.GetType().Name}");
        }
    }
}

```csharp
public class BigIntegerTest

    [Fact]
    public void TestCase20()
    {
        // Example values for demonstration
        // (Replace "_NUM" with actual numbers as appropriate for a real test)
        byte[] bBytes = { 0x12, 0x34, 0x56, 0x78, 0x9A, 0xBC, 0xDE };
        byte[] rBytes = { 0x12, 0x34, 0x56, 0x78, 0x9A, 0xBC, 0xDE };
        int bSign = 1;

        BigInteger aNumber = BigInteger.Zero;
        BigInteger bNumber = new BigInteger(bBytes);
        if (bSign == -1) bNumber = BigInteger.Negate(bNumber);

        BigInteger result = aNumber.Add(bNumber);
        byte[] resBytes = result.ToByteArray();

        for (int i = 0; i < rBytes.Length; i++)
        {
            Assert.True(resBytes[i] == rBytes[i]);
        }
        Assert.Equal(bSign, result.Sign == 0 ? 0 : result.Sign > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }
```

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.TimeZone;

public class FixGpsTimestampInExif {
    // This function fixes the GPS timestamp in EXIF by converting to proper XML tag format
    public static String formatGpsTimestamp(long timeMillis) {
        // Only proceed if a time is recorded (i.e., timeMillis > 0)
        if (timeMillis > 0) {
            Date date = new Date(timeMillis);
            SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy:MM:dd HH:mm:ss");
            sdf.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"));
            // Simulate writing to XML tag for EXIF
            return "<GPSTimeStamp>" + sdf.format(date) + "</GPSTimeStamp>";
        }
        return "";
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example: current time as GPS timestamp
        long gpsTimeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis();

        String fixedTimestampXmlTag = formatGpsTimestamp(gpsTimeMillis);
        System.out.println("Fixed GPS Timestamp EXIF XML Tag:");
        System.out.println(fixedTimestampXmlTag);
    }
}

using System;

namespace GPSTimeStampFixer
{
    // Mock implementations and placeholders for dependencies
    public class XMPNode
    {
        private string _value;

        public XMPNode(string value) { _value = value; }

        public string GetValue() => _value;
    }

    public class XMPNodeUtils
    {
        // For demonstration, always returns a node with the sample date value, or null
        public static XMPNode FindChildNode(XMPNode parent, string name, bool create)
        {
            // Dummy logic: return a sample value or null
            if (name == "_EXIF_GPS_DATE")
                return new XMPNode("2000-01-01T12:00:00Z");
            if (name == "_EXIF_OTHER_DATE")
                return new XMPNode("2010-06-12T15:15:15Z");
            return null;
        }
    }

    public class XMPUtils
    {
        public static XMPDateTime ConvertToDate(string dateValue)
        {
            // Parse the string into XMPDateTime, expecting format "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ"
            return XMPDateTime.Parse(dateValue);
        }
    }

    public class XMPDateTime
    {
        public int Year { get; set; }
        public int Month { get; set; }
        public int Day { get; set; }
        public int Hour { get; set; }
        public int Minute { get; set; }
        public int Second { get; set; }

        public static XMPDateTime Parse(string dateValue)
        {
            DateTime dt = DateTime.Parse(dateValue, null, System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal);
            return new XMPDateTime
            {
                Year = dt.Year,
                Month = dt.Month,
                Day = dt.Day,
                Hour = dt.Hour,
                Minute = dt.Minute,
                Second = dt.Second
            };
        }

        public int GetYear() => Year;
        public int GetMonth() => Month;
        public int GetDay() => Day;
        public Calendar GetCalendar() => new Calendar(this);

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return $"{Year}-{Month:D2}-{Day:D2}T{Hour:D2}:{Minute:D2}:{Second:D2}Z";
        }
    }

    public class Calendar
    {
        private XMPDateTime _dt;
        public const int YEAR = 1;
        public const int MONTH = 2;
        public const int DAY_OF_MONTH = 3;

        public Calendar(XMPDateTime dt)
        {
            _dt = dt;
        }

        public void Set(int field, int value)
        {
            if (field == YEAR) _dt.Year = value;
            else if (field == MONTH) _dt.Month = value;
            else if (field == DAY_OF_MONTH) _dt.Day = value;
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        // Constants used in the snippet
        private static readonly string _STR = "_EXIF_GPS_DATE";
        private static readonly bool _BOOL = false;
        private static readonly int _NUM = 2000; // Example, for demo

        private static void FixGPSTimeStamp(XMPNode exifSchema)
        {
            XMPNode gpsDateTime = XMPNodeUtils.FindChildNode(exifSchema, _STR, _BOOL);
            if (gpsDateTime == null)
            {
                return;
            }
            try
            {
                XMPDateTime binGPSStamp;
                XMPDateTime binOtherDate;
                binGPSStamp = XMPUtils.ConvertToDate(gpsDateTime.GetValue());
                if (binGPSStamp.GetYear() != _NUM || binGPSStamp.GetMonth() != _NUM || binGPSStamp.GetDay() != _NUM)
                {
                    return;
                }
                XMPNode otherDate = XMPNodeUtils.FindChildNode(exifSchema, "_EXIF_OTHER_DATE", _BOOL);
                if (otherDate == null)
                {
                    otherDate = XMPNodeUtils.FindChildNode(exifSchema, "_EXIF_OTHER_DATE", _BOOL);
                }
                binOtherDate = XMPUtils.ConvertToDate(otherDate.GetValue());
                Calendar cal = binGPSStamp.GetCalendar();
                cal.Set(Calendar.YEAR, binOtherDate.GetYear());
                cal.Set(Calendar.MONTH, binOtherDate.GetMonth());
                cal.Set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, binOtherDate.GetDay());
                Console.WriteLine("Fixed GPS DateTime: " + binGPSStamp.ToString());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("Exception in FixGPSTimeStamp: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            XMPNode exifSchema = new XMPNode("root");
            FixGPSTime
    }

using System;
using System.IO;

public class Localizer
{
    public static string GetMessage(string str, string b0)
    {
        return $"Error: {str} Value: {b0}";
    }
}

public class SampleReader
{
    private readonly Stream fInputStream;
    private readonly int _NUM = 127; // ASCII max character value
    private readonly string _STR = "Byte value exceeds limit";

    public SampleReader(Stream inputStream)
    {
        fInputStream = inputStream;
    }

    // read a single character . this method will block until a character is available , an i / o error occurs , or the end of the stream is reached . < p > subclasses that intend to support efficient single - character input should override this method . 
    public int Read()
    {
        int b0 = fInputStream.ReadByte();
        if (b0 > _NUM)
        {
            throw new IOException(Localizer.GetMessage(_STR, b0.ToString()));
        }
        return b0;
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        byte[] data = { 65, 66, 128 }; // 128 > 127 (_NUM)
        using (MemoryStream ms = new MemoryStream(data))
        {
            SampleReader reader = new SampleReader(ms);

            testReadSingleCharacter();
            testReadSingleCharacterInvalid();
            testReadSingleCharacterMultiple();
            testReadSingleCharacterInvalidMultiple();
            testReadSingleCharacterEmpty();

        }
    }
}
